scripts.script:
--[[
    Animation Control Center
    LocalScript
    Place in: StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts

    Features:
    • Disable non-walking animations
    • Walking/running animations remain enabled
    • Draggable GUI
    • Minimize / close
    • Control / Settings / Appearance / Hotkeys / About tabs
    • Multiple themes
    • UI scaling
    • Custom GUI hotkey
    • Notifications
    • Auto-disable non-walking animations on respawn
    • Stop current non-walking animations
]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

--==================================================
-- SETTINGS
--==================================================

local Settings = {
	NonWalkingAnimationsDisabled = false,
	Theme = "Dark",
	UIScale = 1,
	Keybind = Enum.KeyCode.RightShift,
	Notifications = true,
	AutoDisableOnSpawn = false,
}

--==================================================
-- THEMES
--==================================================

local Themes = {
	Dark = {
		Background = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 23),
		Secondary = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 32),
		Card = Color3.fromRGB(31, 31, 40),
		Accent = Color3.fromRGB(80, 140, 255),
		Accent2 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 170, 255),
		Text = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 245),
		SubText = Color3.fromRGB(160, 160, 175),
		Border = Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 70),
		Danger = Color3.fromRGB(230, 75, 75),
		Success = Color3.fromRGB(70, 200, 120),
	},

	Blue = {
		Background = Color3.fromRGB(12, 22, 38),
		Secondary = Color3.fromRGB(18, 32, 52),
		Card = Color3.fromRGB(25, 43, 68),
		Accent = Color3.fromRGB(40, 140, 255),
		Accent2 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 175, 255),
		Text = Color3.fromRGB(235, 245, 255),
		SubText = Color3.fromRGB(150, 180, 210),
		Border = Color3.fromRGB(45, 75, 110),
		Danger = Color3.fromRGB(235, 80, 80),
		Success = Color3.fromRGB(70, 210, 130),
	},

	Purple = {
		Background = Color3.fromRGB(25, 15, 35),
		Secondary = Color3.fromRGB(37, 22, 52),
		Card = Color3.fromRGB(48, 29, 66),
		Accent = Color3.fromRGB(155, 85, 255),
		Accent2 = Color3.fromRGB(185, 125, 255),
		Text = Color3.fromRGB(245, 238, 255),
		SubText = Color3.fromRGB(180, 160, 200),
		Border = Color3.fromRGB(75, 50, 95),
		Danger = Color3.fromRGB(235, 80, 100),
		Success = Color3.fromRGB(75, 210, 135),
	},

	Green = {
		Background = Color3.fromRGB(12, 28, 22),
		Secondary = Color3.fromRGB(18, 42, 32),
		Card = Color3.fromRGB(25, 55, 42),
		Accent = Color3.fromRGB(50, 200, 120),
		Accent2 = Color3.fromRGB(90, 230, 155),
		Text = Color3.fromRGB(235, 255, 245),
		SubText = Color3.fromRGB(155, 195, 175),
		Border = Color3.fromRGB(45, 85, 65),
		Danger = Color3.fromRGB(235, 80, 80),
		Success = Color3.fromRGB(65, 220, 130),
	},
}

local CurrentTheme = Themes[Settings.Theme]

--==================================================
-- HELPERS
--==================================================

local function tween(object, properties, duration)
	local info = TweenInfo.new(
		duration or 0.2,
		Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,
		Enum.EasingDirection.Out
	)

	TweenService:Create(object, info, properties):Play()
end

local function round(object, radius)
	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius or 8)
	corner.Parent = object
	return corner
end

local function addStroke(object, color, thickness)
	local s = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	s.Color = color
	s.Thickness = thickness or 1
	s.Transparency = 0.3
	s.Parent = object
	return s
end

local function create(className, properties, parent)
	local object = Instance.new(className)

	for property, value in pairs(properties or {}) do
		object[property] = value
	end

	object.Parent = parent
	return object
end

--==================================================
-- CHARACTER HELPERS
--==================================================

local animationConnection
local characterConnection

local function getCharacter()
	return player.Character
end

local function getHumanoid()
	local character = getCharacter()

	if not character then
		return nil
	end

	return character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
end

local function getAnimator()
	local humanoid = getHumanoid()

	if not humanoid then
		return nil
	end

	return humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
end

--==================================================
-- WALK/RUN DETECTION
--==================================================

local function animationObjectMatchesTrack(animationObject, track)
	if not animationObject:IsA("Animation") then
		return false
	end

	if not track.Animation then
		return false
	end

	if animationObject.AnimationId == "" then
		return false
	end

	return animationObject.AnimationId == track.Animation.AnimationId
end

local function isDefaultMovementAnimation(track)
	local character = getCharacter()

	if not character then
		return false
	end

	local animate = character:FindFirstChild("Animate")

	if not animate then
		return false
	end

	-- Roblox default walking animations
	local walkFolder = animate:FindFirstChild("walk")

	if walkFolder then
		for _, object in ipairs(walkFolder:GetDescendants()) do
			if animationObjectMatchesTrack(object, track) then
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	-- Roblox default running animations
	local runFolder = animate:FindFirstChild("run")

	if runFolder then
		for _, object in ipairs(runFolder:GetDescendants()) do
			if animationObjectMatchesTrack(object, track) then
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

local function isWalkingAnimation(track)
	local name = string.lower(track.Name or "")

	-- Common names used by custom animation systems.
	if string.find(name, "walk", 1, true) then
		return true
	end

	if string.find(name, "run", 1, true) then
		return true
	end

	-- Check Roblox's Animate script.
	if isDefaultMovementAnimation(track) then
		return true
	end

	return false
end

--==================================================
-- ANIMATION CONTROL
--==================================================

local function stopNonWalkingAnimations()
	local animator = getAnimator()

	if not animator then
		return
	end

	for _, track in ipairs(animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
		if not isWalkingAnimation(track) then
			pcall(function()
				track:Stop(0)
			end)
		end
	end
end

local function disconnectAnimationListener()
	if animationConnection then
		animationConnection:Disconnect()
		animationConnection = nil
	end
end

local function connectAnimationListener()
	disconnectAnimationListener()

	local animator = getAnimator()

	if not animator then
		return
	end

	animationConnection = animator.AnimationPlayed:Connect(function(track)
		if not Settings.NonWalkingAnimationsDisabled then
			return
		end

		if isWalkingAnimation(track) then
			return
		end

		task.defer(function()
			if Settings.NonWalkingAnimationsDisabled then
				pcall(function()
					track:Stop(0)
				end)
			end
		end)
	end)
end

local function disableNonWalkingAnimations()
	Settings.NonWalkingAnimationsDisabled = true

	stopNonWalkingAnimations()
	connectAnimationListener()
end

local function enableAllAnimations()
	Settings.NonWalkingAnimationsDisabled = false

	disconnectAnimationListener()
end

local function toggleNonWalkingAnimations()
	if Settings.NonWalkingAnimationsDisabled then
		enableAllAnimations()
	else
		disableNonWalkingAnimations()
	end
end

--==================================================
-- GUI
--==================================================

local gui = create("ScreenGui", {
	Name = "AnimationControlCenter",
	ResetOnSpawn = false,
	ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling,
}, playerGui)

local main = create("Frame", {
	Name = "Main",
	Size = UDim2.fromOffset(650, 430),
	Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -325, 0.5, -215),
	BackgroundColor3 = CurrentTheme.Background,
	BorderSizePixel = 0,
	ClipsDescendants = true,
}, gui)

round(main, 14)
addStroke(main, CurrentTheme.Border, 1)

local uiScale = create("UIScale", {
	Scale = Settings.UIScale,
}, main)

--==================================================
-- TOP BAR
--==================================================

local topBar = create("Frame", {
	Name = "TopBar",
	Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 58),
	BackgroundColor3 = CurrentTheme.Secondary,
	BorderSizePixel = 0,
}, main)

local title = create("TextLabel", {
	Size = UDim2.new(0, 350, 0, 25),
	Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 7),
	BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	Text = "Animation Control Center",
	TextColor3 = CurrentTheme.Text,
	Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
	TextSize = 18,
	TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
}, topBar)

local subtitle = create("TextLabel", {
	Size = UDim2.new(0, 350, 0, 18),
	Position = UDim2.fromOffset(21, 32),
	BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	Text = "Walking animations stay active",
	TextColor3 = CurrentTheme.SubText,
	Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
	TextSize = 10,
	TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
}, topBar)

local minimizeButton = create("TextButton", {
	Size = UDim2.fromOffset(38, 38),
	Position = UDim2.new(1, -92, 0, 10),
	BackgroundColor3 = CurrentTheme.Card,
	Text = "−",
	TextColor3 = CurrentTheme.Text,
	Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
	TextSize = 22,
	AutoButtonColor = false,
}, topBar)

round(minimizeButton, 8)

local closeButton = create("TextButton", {
	Size = UDim2.fromOffset(38, 38),
	Position = UDim2.new(1, -48, 0, 10),
	BackgroundColor3 = CurrentTheme.Card,
	Text = "×",
	TextColor3 = CurrentTheme.Text,
	Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
	TextSize = 24,
	AutoButtonColor = false,
}, topBar)

round(closeButton, 8)

--==================================================
-- SIDEBAR
--==================================================

local sidebar = create("Frame", {
	Name = "Sidebar",
	Size = UDim2.new(0, 150, 1, -58),
	Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 58),
	BackgroundColor3 = CurrentTheme.Secondary,
	BorderSizePixel = 0,
}, main)

create("UIPadding", {
	PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 15),
	PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 10),
	PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 10),
}, sidebar)

create("UIListLayout", {
	Padding = UDim.new(0, 6),
	HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center,
	SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
}, sidebar)

--==================================================
-- CONTENT
--==================================================

local content = create("Frame", {
	Name = "Content",
	Size = UDim2.new(1, -150, 1, -58),
	Position = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 58),
	BackgroundColor3 = CurrentTheme.Background,
	BorderSizePixel = 0,
}, main)

--==================================================
-- NOTIFICATIONS
--==================================================

local notificationHolder = create("Frame", {
	Name = "Notifications",
	Size = UDim2.fromOffset(320, 400),
	Position = UDim2.new(1, -330, 0, 15),
	BackgroundTransparency = 1,
}, gui)

create("UIListLayout", {
	VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Bottom,
	HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right,
	Padding = UDim.new(0, 8),
}, notificationHolder)

local function notify(message, color)
	if not Settings.Notifications then
		return
	end

	local notification = create("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(300, 55),
		BackgroundColor3 = CurrentTheme.Card,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
	}, notificationHolder)

	round(notification, 10)
	addStroke(notification, color or CurrentTheme.Accent, 1)

	create("TextLabel", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, 0),
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 0),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Text = message,
		TextColor3 = CurrentTheme.Text,
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
		TextSize = 13,
		TextWrapped = true,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
	}, notification)

	notification.Position = UDim2.new(1, 30, 0, 0)

	tween(notification, {
		Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	}, 0.25)

	task.delay(2.5, function()
		if notification.Parent then
			tween(notification, {
				Position = UDim2.new(1, 30, 0, 0)
			}, 0.25)

			task.wait(0.3)

			if notification.Parent then
				notification:Destroy()
			end
		end
	end)
end

--==================================================
-- TABS
--==================================================

local tabs = {}
local pages = {}

local function createTab(name, icon)
	local button = create("TextButton", {
		Name = name .. "Tab",
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 42),
		BackgroundColor3 = CurrentTheme.Secondary,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Text = icon .. "  " .. name,
		TextColor3 = CurrentTheme.SubText,
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
		TextSize = 13,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		AutoButtonColor = false,
	}, sidebar)

	round(button, 8)

	create("UIPadding", {
		PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 14),
	}, button)

	local page = create("ScrollingFrame", {
		Name = name .. "Page",
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 1, -30),
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(15, 15),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		ScrollBarThickness = 4,
		ScrollBarImageColor3 = CurrentTheme.Accent,
		CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
		AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		Visible = false,
	}, content)

	create("UIListLayout", {
		Padding = UDim.new(0, 12),
		SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
	}, page)

	tabs[name] = button
	pages[name] = page

	return button, page
end

--==================================================
-- UI COMPONENTS
--==================================================

local function createSectionTitle(parent, text)
	return create("TextLabel", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 28),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Text = text,
		TextColor3 = CurrentTheme.Text,
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
		TextSize = 16,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
	}, parent)
end

local function createCard(parent, height)
	local card = create("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, height or 70),
		BackgroundColor3 = CurrentTheme.Card,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
	}, parent)

	round(card, 10)
	addStroke(card, CurrentTheme.Border, 1)

	return card
end

local function createToggle(parent, titleText, description, initial, callback)
	local card = createCard(parent, 70)

	create("TextLabel", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -100, 0, 24),
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(15, 10),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Text = titleText,
		TextColor3 = CurrentTheme.Text,
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
		TextSize = 13,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
	}, card)

	create("TextLabel", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -100, 0, 25),
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(15, 34),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Text = description,
		TextColor3 = CurrentTheme.SubText,
		Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
		TextSize = 10,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		TextWrapped = true,
	}, card)

	local toggle = create("TextButton", {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(52, 28),
		Position = UDim2.new(1, -67, 0.5, -14),
		BackgroundColor3 = initial and CurrentTheme.Success or CurrentTheme.Border,
		Text = "",
		AutoButtonColor = false,
	}, card)

	round(toggle, 14)

	local knob = create("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(22, 22),
		Position = initial
			and UDim2.new(1, -25, 0.5, -11)
			or UDim2.new(0, 3, 0.5, -11),
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
	}, toggle)

	round(knob, 50)

	local state = initial

	local function setState(value)
		state = value

		tween(toggle, {
			BackgroundColor3 = state
				and CurrentTheme.Success
				or CurrentTheme.Border
		})

		tween(knob, {
			Position = state
				and UDim2.new(1, -25, 0.5, -11)
				or UDim2.new(0, 3, 0.5, -11)
		})

		if callback then
			callback(state)
		end
	end

	toggle.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		setState(not state)
	end)

	return card, setState
end

local function createButton(parent, text, callback, color)
	local normalColor = color or CurrentTheme.Accent

	local button = create("TextButton", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 50),
		BackgroundColor3 = normalColor,
		Text = text,
		TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
		TextSize = 13,
		AutoButtonColor = false,
	}, parent)

	round(button, 9)

	button.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		tween(button, {
			BackgroundColor3 = CurrentTheme.Accent2
		})
	end)

	button.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		tween(button, {
			BackgroundColor3 = normalColor
		})
	end)

	button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(callback)

	return button
end

--==================================================
-- CONTROL TAB
--==================================================

local controlTab, controlPage = createTab("Control", "●")

createSectionTitle(controlPage, "Animation Control")

local animationCard = createCard(controlPage, 115)

local animationTitle = create("TextLabel", {
	Size = UDim2.new(1, -160, 0, 25),
	Position = UDim2.fromOffset(15, 12),
	BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	Text = "Non-Walking Animation System",
	TextColor3 = CurrentTheme.Text,
	Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
	TextSize = 15,
	TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
}, animationCard)

local animationStatus = create("TextLabel", {
	Size = UDim2.new(1, -160, 0, 45),
	Position = UDim2.fromOffset(15, 42),
	BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	Text = "All animations are currently allowed.",
	TextColor3 = CurrentTheme.SubText,
	Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
	TextSize = 11,
	TextWrapped = true,
	TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
}, animationCard)

local animationToggle = create("TextButton", {
	Size = UDim2.fromOffset(120, 40),
	Position = UDim2.new(1, -135, 0.5, -20),
	BackgroundColor3 = CurrentTheme.Accent,
	Text = "BLOCK",
	TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
	Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
	TextSize = 12,
	AutoButtonColor = false,
}, animationCard)

round(animationToggle, 8)

local function updateAnimationButton()
	if Settings.NonWalkingAnimationsDisabled then
		animationToggle.Text = "ALLOW ALL"
		animationToggle.BackgroundColor3 = CurrentTheme.Success

		animationStatus.Text =
			"Non-walking animations are blocked.\nWalking and running animations remain active."

		animationStatus.TextColor3 = CurrentTheme.Success
	else
		animationToggle.Text = "BLOCK"
		animationToggle.BackgroundColor3 = CurrentTheme.Accent

		animationStatus.Text =
			"All animations are currently allowed.\nWalking, jumping, idle, emotes, etc. can play."

		animationStatus.TextColor3 = CurrentTheme.SubText
	end
end

animationToggle.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	toggleNonWalkingAnimations()
	updateAnimationButton()

	if Settings.NonWalkingAnimationsDisabled then
		notify(
			"Non-walking animations blocked. Walking remains enabled.",
			CurrentTheme.Success
		)
	else
		notify(
			"All animations are allowed again.",
			CurrentTheme.Accent
		)
	end
end)

createButton(controlPage, "Stop Non-Walking Animations Now", function()
	stopNonWalkingAnimations()

	notify(
		"Current non-walking animations stopped.",
		CurrentTheme.Accent
	)
end)

createToggle(
	controlPage,
	"Block Non-Walking Animations",
	"Blocks idle, jump, fall, climb, swim, emotes and other animations while allowing walking/running.",
	Settings.NonWalkingAnimationsDisabled,
	function(state)
		if state then
			disableNonWalkingAnimations()
		else
			enableAllAnimations()
		end

		updateAnimationButton()
	end
)

createSectionTitle(controlPage, "Quick Actions")

createButton(controlPage, "Allow All Animations", function()
	enableAllAnimations()
	updateAnimationButton()

	notify(
		"All animations have been enabled.",
		CurrentTheme.Success
	)
end)

--==================================================
-- SETTINGS TAB
--==================================================

local settingsTab, settingsPage = createTab("Settings", "⚙")

createSectionTitle(settingsPage, "General Settings")

createToggle(
	settingsPage,
	"Notifications",
	"Show popup notifications when actions are performed.",
	Settings.Notifications,
	function(state)
		Settings.Notifications = state
	end
)

createToggle(
	settingsPage,
	"Block On Respawn",
	"Automatically block non-walking animations when your character respawns.",
	Settings.AutoDisableOnSpawn,
	function(state)
		Settings.AutoDisableOnSpawn = state
	end
)

local scaleCard = createCard(settingsPage, 75)

create("TextLabel", {
	Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 25),
	Position = UDim2.fromOffset(15, 10),
	BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	Text = "UI Scale",
	TextColor3 = CurrentTheme.Text,
	Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
	TextSize = 13,
	TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
}, scaleCard)

local scaleValue = create("TextLabel", {
	Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 20),
	Position = UDim2.fromOffset(15, 35),
	BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	Text = "100%",
	TextColor3 = CurrentTheme.SubText,
	Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
	TextSize = 10,
	TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
}, scaleCard)

local scaleMinus = create("TextButton", {
	Size = UDim2.fromOffset(35, 35),
	Position = UDim2.new(1, -85, 0.5, -17),
	BackgroundColor3 = CurrentTheme.Secondary,
	Text = "−",
	TextColor3 = CurrentTheme.Text,
	Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
	TextSize = 18,
	AutoButtonColor = false,
}, scaleCard)

round(scaleMinus, 7)

local scalePlus = create("TextButton", {
	Size = UDim2.fromOffset(35, 35),
	Position = UDim2.new(1, -45, 0.5, -17),
	BackgroundColor3 = CurrentTheme.Secondary,
	Text = "+",
	TextColor3 = CurrentTheme.Text,
	Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
	TextSize = 18,
	AutoButtonColor = false,
}, scaleCard)

round(scalePlus, 7)

local function updateScale()
	uiScale.Scale = Settings.UIScale
	scaleValue.Text = math.floor(Settings.UIScale * 100) .. "%"
end

scaleMinus.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	Settings.UIScale = math.max(0.75, Settings.UIScale - 0.05)
	updateScale()
end)

scalePlus.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	Settings.UIScale = math.min(1.5, Settings.UIScale + 0.05)
	updateScale()
end)

--==================================================
-- APPEARANCE TAB
--==================================================

local appearanceTab, appearancePage = createTab("Appearance", "◆")

createSectionTitle(appearancePage, "Themes")

local themeNames = {
	"Dark",
	"Blue",
	"Purple",
	"Green",
}

for _, themeName in ipairs(themeNames) do
	local theme = Themes[themeName]

	local button = create("TextButton", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 55),
		BackgroundColor3 = theme.Card,
		Text = "     " .. themeName,
		TextColor3 = theme.Text,
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
		TextSize = 13,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,

	}, appearancePage)

	round(button, 9)

	local indicator = create("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(7, 35),
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10),
		BackgroundColor3 = theme.Accent,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
	}, button)

	round(indicator, 5)

	button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		Settings.Theme = themeName
		CurrentTheme = Themes[themeName]

		main.BackgroundColor3 = CurrentTheme.Background
		content.BackgroundColor3 = CurrentTheme.Background
		sidebar.BackgroundColor3 = CurrentTheme.Secondary
		topBar.BackgroundColor3 = CurrentTheme.Secondary

		title.TextColor3 = CurrentTheme.Text
		subtitle.TextColor3 = CurrentTheme.SubText

		updateAnimationButton()

		notify(
			"Theme changed to " .. themeName .. ".",
			CurrentTheme.Accent
		)

end

--==================================================
-- HOTKEY TAB
--==================================================

local hotkeyTab, hotkeyPage = createTab("Hotkeys", "⌨")

createSectionTitle(hotkeyPage, "Keyboard Shortcuts")

local keybindCard = createCard(hotkeyPage, 90)

create("TextLabel", {
	Size = UDim2.new(1, -150, 0, 25),
	Position = UDim2.fromOffset(15, 12),
	BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	Text = "Toggle GUI",
	TextColor3 = CurrentTheme.Text,
	Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
	TextSize = 13,
	TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
}, keybindCard)

create("TextLabel", {
	Size = UDim2.new(1, -150, 0, 25),
	Position = UDim2.fromOffset(15, 40),
	BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	Text = "Press your chosen key to show/hide the interface.",
	TextColor3 = CurrentTheme.SubText,
	Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
	TextSize = 10,
	TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
}, keybindCard)

local keyButton = create("TextButton", {
	Size = UDim2.fromOffset(110, 38),
	Position = UDim2.new(1, -125, 0.5, -19),
	BackgroundColor3 = CurrentTheme.Accent,
	Text = Settings.Keybind.Name,
	TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
	Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
	TextSize = 12,
	AutoButtonColor = false,
}, keybindCard)

round(keyButton, 8)

local waitingForKey = false

keyButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	waitingForKey = true
	keyButton.Text = "PRESS KEY..."
	keyButton.BackgroundColor3 = CurrentTheme.Success
end)

--==================================================
-- ABOUT TAB
--==================================================

local aboutTab, aboutPage = createTab("About", "ⓘ")

createSectionTitle(aboutPage, "Animation Control Center")

local aboutCard = createCard(aboutPage, 190)

create("TextLabel", {
	Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 1, -20),
	Position = UDim2.fromOffset(15, 10),
	BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	Text =
		"Client-side animation controller\n\n" ..
		"• Walking animations remain active\n" ..
		"• Running animations remain active\n" ..
		"• Idle animations can be blocked\n" ..
		"• Jump animations can be blocked\n" ..
		"• Fall animations can be blocked\n" ..
		"• Climb animations can be blocked\n" ..
		"• Swim animations can be blocked\n" ..
		"• Emotes and other animation tracks can be blocked\n\n" ..
		"All changes made by this LocalScript affect your local client.",
	TextColor3 = CurrentTheme.SubText,
	Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
	TextSize = 12,
	TextWrapped = true,
	TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
	TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top,
}, aboutCard)

--==================================================
-- TAB SWITCHING
--==================================================

local function selectTab(tabName)
	for name, button in pairs(tabs) do
		if name == tabName then
			button.BackgroundTransparency = 0
			button.BackgroundColor3 = CurrentTheme.Card
			button.TextColor3 = CurrentTheme.Text
		else
			button.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			button.BackgroundColor3 = CurrentTheme.Secondary
			button.TextColor3 = CurrentTheme.SubText
		end
	end

	for name, page in pairs(pages) do
		page.Visible = name == tabName
	end
end

for name, button in pairs(tabs) do
	button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		selectTab(name)
	end)
end

selectTab("Control")

--==================================================
-- DRAGGING
--==================================================

local dragging = false
local dragStart
local startPosition

topBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

		dragging = true
		dragStart = input.Position
		startPosition = main.Position

		input.Changed:Connect(function()
			if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
				dragging = false
			end
		end)
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if not dragging then
		return
	end

	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

		local delta = input.Position - dragStart

		main.Position = UDim2.new(
			startPosition.X.Scale,
			startPosition.X.Offset + delta.X,
			startPosition.Y.Scale,
			startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y
		)
	end
end)

--==================================================
-- MINIMIZE
--==================================================

local minimized = false
local normalSize = UDim2.fromOffset(650, 430)

minimizeButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	minimized = not minimized

	if minimized then
		minimizeButton.Text = "+"
		main.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(650, 58)
	else
		minimizeButton.Text = "−"
		main.Size = normalSize
	end
end)

--==================================================
-- CLOSE
--==================================================

closeButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	main.Visible = false
end)

--==================================================
-- KEYBOARD INPUT
--==================================================

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
	if processed then
		return
	end

	if waitingForKey then
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
			Settings.Keybind = input.KeyCode
			keyButton.Text = input.KeyCode.Name
			keyButton.BackgroundColor3 = CurrentTheme.Accent

			waitingForKey = false

			notify(
				"GUI keybind changed to " .. input.KeyCode.Name .. ".",
				CurrentTheme.Success
			)
		end

		return
	end

	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
		if input.KeyCode == Settings.Keybind then
			main.Visible = not main.Visible
		end
	end
end)

--==================================================
-- CHARACTER RESPAWN
--==================================================

if characterConnection then
	characterConnection:Disconnect()
end

characterConnection = player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
	task.wait(0.5)

	-- The Animator may not exist immediately after spawning.
	local character = player.Character

	if character then
		local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)

		if humanoid then
			humanoid:WaitForChild("Animator", 5)
		end
	end

	if Settings.NonWalkingAnimationsDisabled
		or Settings.AutoDisableOnSpawn then

		disableNonWalkingAnimations()
		updateAnimationButton()
	end
end)

--==================================================
-- INITIALIZE
--==================================================

updateAnimationButton()
updateScale()

notify(
	"Animation Control Center loaded.",
	CurrentTheme.Success
)

scripts.features:
This Script can...

- Force Close All Doors: Attempts to close every detected door and gate using its current position or state.

- Force Open All Doors: Attempts to open every detected door and gate.

- Auto-Lock Loop: Repeatedly closes doors that open and calls stopped lifts back to the top floor.

- Auto Sprinklers: Turns sprinklers on once. If someone turns them off afterward, it leaves them off until you restart the toggle.

- 096 / 106 Gate Inversion: Reverses how the script interprets each chamber gate’s open/closed state if its controls behave backward. So if the script keeps repeately opening the 096v or 106 chambers just click this button on the chamber tahts acting up to change teh driection of where this closes. Thsi happens because the script reads it as "I dont know whats close or open so I will use the location of where its at now as close" so if its open in a public server already, the script will read the chamber as close even if its open. Thats why theres an inversion button for the script.

- Spam Gameplay Buttons: Clicks eligible controls independently, choosing a new random 0.25–4 second interval before each click. Includes doors, gates, lift controls, and newly added ClickDetectors.
                 - Spam Exclusions: Skips controls identified as morphs, gamepasses,      purchases, clothing, cosmetics, team selectors, or spawns. Identification uses etector and ancestor names, so unusually named controls may need extra exclusions.

- Print & Copy Door States: Prints a diagnostic report to the F9 console and attempts to copy it to your clipboard. Includes door states, lift positions, and sprinkler details. (THIS IS MAINLY FOR WHEN I WAS CREATING THE SCRIPT. ALTHOUGH YOU CAN USE IT TO IMPROVE THE SCRIPT FOR YOUR OWN)

Panel controls
- Drag the title bar: Moves the panel.
- Drag the bottom-right corner: Resizes the panel.
- Minimize (−): Collapses the panel while active features keep running.
- X or P: Closes the GUI and stops all loops and pending tasks started by this script.
- Automatic cleanup: Also stops the script’s tasks if the GUI is removed, destroyed, hidden, or disabled. Running a new copy shuts down the previous copy first. (might be broken)
Door detection depends on the map’s structure. Single-part doors and chamber gates are assumed to be closed when the script first runs.

NOTE: I was banned from the game but have no idea if it was the script, me flying, or another script I was using which is unrelated. so in any case test the script on an alt account and send in a review to help others :D 

btw open source. pls improve exploits :p

scripts.script:
-- Remove any previous copy of this script (and stop its loops)
local env = (getgenv and getgenv()) or _G
if env.FacilityControlStop then pcall(env.FacilityControlStop) end
for _, g in ipairs(game:GetService("CoreGui"):GetChildren()) do
	if g.Name == "FacilityControlV5" or g.Name == "FacilityControl" then g:Destroy() end
end

local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

-- Create ScreenGui inside CoreGui to persist across respawns
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "FacilityControl"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
screenGui.Parent = game:GetService("CoreGui")

-- GUI settings
local VERSION = "v6.0"
local TITLE_H = 36 -- Height of the title bar (also the height when minimized)
local MIN_W, MAX_W = 230, 520 -- Resize limits (width)
local MIN_H, MAX_H = 180, 700 -- Resize limits (height)

-- State variables
local running = true -- set to false when a newer copy of the script replaces this one
local autoCloseActive = false
local autoSprinklersActive = false
local spamActive = false
local connections = {} -- Event connections to clean up when replaced
local originalPositions = {} -- Closed-position baseline for single-part doors and chamber gates
local lastFired = {} -- Tracks when each door was last clicked (for auto-lock cooldown)
local AUTO_LOCK_COOLDOWN = 2.5 -- Seconds to wait after clicking a door before checking it again
local SPRINKLER_COOLDOWN = 3 -- Seconds to wait after clicking the sprinkler lever
local SPRINKLER_RESUME_AFTER = math.huge -- Seconds before auto sprinklers re-enable after someone turns them off (math.huge = never)
local SPAM_MIN_INTERVAL = 0.25 -- Shortest delay per detector
local SPAM_MAX_INTERVAL = 4 -- Longest delay; randomized after every click
local spamGeneration = 0 -- Invalidates workers on OFF/ON
local spamWorkers = {}
local spamRandom = Random.new()
local LIFT_COOLDOWN = 12 -- Seconds to wait after calling a lift up before checking it again
local CLOSED_TOLERANCE = 0.75 -- Studs of slack when deciding if two door panels are touching
local INVERT_096 = false -- Flips open/closed reading for the 096 gate (toggled by its button)
local INVERT_106 = false -- Flips open/closed reading for the grey box (106) gate (toggled by its button)

local function track(conn)
	table.insert(connections, conn)
	return conn
end

env.FacilityControlStop = function()
	running = false
	autoCloseActive = false
	autoSprinklersActive = false
	spamActive = false
	for _, c in ipairs(connections) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
	pcall(function() screenGui:Destroy() end)
end


-- GUI --

local COLOR_PANEL   = Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 33)
local COLOR_TITLE   = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 26)
local COLOR_CARD    = Color3.fromRGB(38, 38, 45)
local COLOR_STROKE  = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 70)
local COLOR_ACCENT  = Color3.fromRGB(110, 160, 255)
local COLOR_TEXT    = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240)
local COLOR_MUTED   = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 160)
local COLOR_OFF     = Color3.fromRGB(75, 75, 80)

local expandedHeight = 450
local minimized = false

-- Main Frame Panel
local mainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
mainFrame.Name = "MainPanel"
mainFrame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(270, expandedHeight)
mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -135, 0.5, -225)
mainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = COLOR_PANEL
mainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
mainFrame.Active = true
mainFrame.ClipsDescendants = true
mainFrame.Parent = screenGui

local mainCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
mainCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
mainCorner.Parent = mainFrame

local mainStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
mainStroke.Color = COLOR_STROKE
mainStroke.Thickness = 1
mainStroke.Parent = mainFrame

-- Title Bar (drag handle)
local titleBar = Instance.new("Frame")
titleBar.Name = "TitleBar"
titleBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, TITLE_H)
titleBar.BackgroundColor3 = COLOR_TITLE
titleBar.BorderSizePixel = 0
titleBar.Active = true
titleBar.Parent = mainFrame

local titleCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
titleCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
titleCorner.Parent = titleBar

local titleLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
titleLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -80, 1, 0)
titleLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 0)
titleLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
titleLabel.RichText = true
titleLabel.Text = 'Facility Control | Created By ContainsCats. Follow ContainsCats on ScripBlox for more!  <font color="rgb(110,160,255)">' .. VERSION .. '</font>'
titleLabel.TextColor3 = COLOR_TEXT
titleLabel.TextSize = 15
titleLabel.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
titleLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
titleLabel.Parent = titleBar

local function createTitleButton(text, xOffset, textColor)
	local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 24, 0, 24)
	btn.Position = UDim2.new(1, xOffset, 0, 6)
	btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 55)
	btn.Text = text
	btn.TextColor3 = textColor
	btn.TextSize = 16
	btn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
	btn.AutoButtonColor = true
	btn.Parent = titleBar
	
	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
	corner.Parent = btn
	return btn
end

local minimizeBtn = createTitleButton("-", -58, COLOR_TEXT)
local closeGuiBtn = createTitleButton("X", -30, Color3.fromRGB(230, 80, 80))

-- Scrollable body that holds the button groups
local body = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
body.Name = "Body"
body.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, TITLE_H)
body.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -TITLE_H)
body.BackgroundTransparency = 1
body.BorderSizePixel = 0
body.ScrollBarThickness = 4
body.ScrollBarImageColor3 = COLOR_STROKE
body.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
body.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
body.Parent = mainFrame

local bodyLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
bodyLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 8)
bodyLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
bodyLayout.Parent = body

local bodyPadding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
bodyPadding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 8)
bodyPadding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 10)
bodyPadding.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 8)
bodyPadding.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 24) -- room for the resize grip
bodyPadding.Parent = body

-- Builds a group card with a heading and description. Buttons are parented to the returned card.
local function createGroup(title, description, order)
	local card = Instance.new("Frame")
	card.Name = title
	card.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	card.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	card.BackgroundColor3 = COLOR_CARD
	card.BorderSizePixel = 0
	card.LayoutOrder = order
	card.Parent = body
	
	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
	corner.Parent = card
	
	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.Color = COLOR_STROKE
	stroke.Thickness = 1
	stroke.Parent = card
	
	local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding")
	pad.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 10)
	pad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 10)
	pad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 10)
	pad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 10)
	pad.Parent = card
	
	local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 6)
	layout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
	layout.Parent = card
	
	local header = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	header.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18)
	header.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	header.Text = string.upper(title)
	header.TextColor3 = COLOR_ACCENT
	header.TextSize = 13
	header.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
	header.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	header.LayoutOrder = 0
	header.Parent = card
	
	local desc = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	desc.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	desc.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	desc.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	desc.Text = description
	desc.TextColor3 = COLOR_MUTED
	desc.TextSize = 13
	desc.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
	desc.TextWrapped = true
	desc.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	desc.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
	desc.LayoutOrder = 1
	desc.Parent = card
	
	return card
end

-- Full-width button inside a group card
local function createButton(parent, text, color, order)
	local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 36)
	btn.BackgroundColor3 = color
	btn.Text = text
	btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	btn.TextSize = 15
	btn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
	btn.LayoutOrder = order
	btn.Parent = parent
	
	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
	corner.Parent = btn
	return btn
end

-- A row holding two half-width buttons side by side
local function createSplitRow(parent, order)
	local row = Instance.new("Frame")
	row.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 36)
	row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	row.LayoutOrder = order
	row.Parent = parent
	return row
end

local function createHalfButton(row, text, rightSide)
	local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	btn.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -3, 1, 0)
	btn.Position = rightSide and UDim2.new(0.5, 3, 0, 0) or UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
	btn.BackgroundColor3 = COLOR_OFF
	btn.Text = text
	btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	btn.TextSize = 14
	btn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
	btn.Parent = row
	
	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
	corner.Parent = btn
	return btn
end

-- GROUP 1: Door Control
local doorGroup = createGroup("Door Control",
	"One-shot commands that close or open every door and gate in the facility.", 1)
local closeDoorsBtn = createButton(doorGroup, "Force Close All Doors", Color3.fromRGB(180, 55, 55), 2)
local openDoorsBtn  = createButton(doorGroup, "Force Open All Doors", Color3.fromRGB(55, 150, 55), 3)

-- GROUP 2: Automation
local autoGroup = createGroup("Automation",
	"Loops that run until you switch them off. Auto-Lock re-closes any door that gets opened and keeps the lifts parked on top. Auto Sprinklers turns the sprinklers on once.", 2)
local autoCloseBtn     = createButton(autoGroup, "Auto-Lock Loop: OFF", COLOR_OFF, 2)
local autoSprinklerBtn = createButton(autoGroup, "Auto Sprinklers: OFF", COLOR_OFF, 3)

-- GROUP 3: Chamber Gates
local gateGroup = createGroup("Chamber Gates",
	"If the 096 gate or the grey box (106) gate acts backwards, press its button to invert how open and closed are read.", 3)
local gateRow = createSplitRow(gateGroup, 2)
local invert096Btn = createHalfButton(gateRow, "096: Normal", false)
local invert106Btn = createHalfButton(gateRow, "106: Normal", true)

-- GROUP 4: Utilities
local utilGroup = createGroup("Utilities",
	"Spam clicks gameplay buttons independently at random intervals, skipping purchases, morphs, clothing changes and team selectors. The report prints to F9 and copies door, lift and sprinkler info.", 4)
local spamButtonsBtn = createButton(utilGroup, "Spam Gameplay Buttons: OFF", Color3.fromRGB(55, 110, 180), 2)
local debugBtn       = createButton(utilGroup, "Print & Copy Door States", Color3.fromRGB(90, 70, 140), 3)

-- Footer hint
local hint = Instance.new("TextLabel")
hint.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16)
hint.BackgroundTransparency = 1
hint.Text = "Press P to show / hide this panel"
hint.TextColor3 = COLOR_MUTED
hint.TextSize = 12
hint.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
hint.LayoutOrder = 5
hint.Parent = body

-- Resize grip (bottom-right corner)
local resizeGrip = Instance.new("TextButton")
resizeGrip.Name = "ResizeGrip"
resizeGrip.Size = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 20)
resizeGrip.Position = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, -20)
resizeGrip.BackgroundTransparency = 1
resizeGrip.Text = "◢"
resizeGrip.TextColor3 = COLOR_MUTED
resizeGrip.TextSize = 16
resizeGrip.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
resizeGrip.ZIndex = 5
resizeGrip.Parent = mainFrame

-- Dragging (title bar) and resizing (grip)
local dragging, dragStart, dragStartPos = false, nil, nil
local resizing, resizeStart, resizeStartSize = false, nil, nil

local function isPointerStart(input)
	return input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
end

track(titleBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if isPointerStart(input) then
		dragging = true
		dragStart = input.Position
		dragStartPos = mainFrame.Position
		input.Changed:Connect(function()
			if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then dragging = false end
		end)
	end
end))

track(resizeGrip.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if isPointerStart(input) and not minimized then
		resizing = true
		resizeStart = input.Position
		resizeStartSize = mainFrame.AbsoluteSize
		input.Changed:Connect(function()
			if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then resizing = false end
		end)
	end
end))

track(UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		return
	end
	
	if dragging then
		local d = input.Position - dragStart
		mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(
			dragStartPos.X.Scale, dragStartPos.X.Offset + d.X,
			dragStartPos.Y.Scale, dragStartPos.Y.Offset + d.Y)
	elseif resizing then
		local d = input.Position - resizeStart
		local w = math.clamp(resizeStartSize.X + d.X, MIN_W, MAX_W)
		local h = math.clamp(resizeStartSize.Y + d.Y, MIN_H, MAX_H)
		expandedHeight = h
		mainFrame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h)
	end
end))

-- Minimize / restore
minimizeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	minimized = not minimized
	body.Visible = not minimized
	resizeGrip.Visible = not minimized
	minimizeBtn.Text = minimized and "+" or "-"
	local w = mainFrame.AbsoluteSize.X
	mainFrame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, minimized and TITLE_H or expandedHeight)
end)

-- Toggle Visibility Hook (X Button hides, pressing 'P' shows / hides)
closeGuiBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	mainFrame.Visible = false
end)

track(UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
	if not gameProcessed and input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.P then
		mainFrame.Visible = not mainFrame.Visible

-- CORE LOGIC FOR SYSTEM FILTERING AND STATE MANAGEMENT --

-- Ancestor-name keywords that mark a button as off-limits (purchases, morphs, teams, spawns)
local BLOCKED_KEYWORDS = {
	"gamepass", "game pass", "robux", "donate", "buy", "purchase", "product",
	"vip", "shop", "team", "morph", "skin", "outfit", "costume", "cosmetic", "spawn",
	"cloth", "shirt", "pants", "trouser", "uniform", "dress", "wardrobe", "accessor", "avatar",
}

-- Filter out purchasing interfaces, dev products, gamepasses, morphs, and team selectors
local function isSafeGameplayButton(detector)
	local parent = detector.Parent
	if not parent then return false end
	
	local current = detector
	while current and current ~= workspace do
		local nameLower = string.lower(current.Name)
		for _, word in ipairs(BLOCKED_KEYWORDS) do
			if string.find(nameLower, word, 1, true) then
				return false
			end
		end
		current = current.Parent
	end
	return true
end

-- A "door" is any model named Door/Gate, inside a Gates folder, or containing a Door1 part
-- (this also catches things like Lift > BottomGate). The Lift model itself is NOT a door.
local function isDoorModel(model)
	if not model:IsA("Model") then return false end
	if model.Name == "Lift" then return false end
	if model.Name == "Gate" or model.Name == "Door" then return true end
	if model.Parent and string.lower(model.Parent.Name) == "gates" then return true end
	local d1 = model:FindFirstChild("Door1")
	if d1 and d1:IsA("BasePart") then return true end
	return false
end

-- True for the TopGate / BottomGate models that belong to a lift
local function isLiftGate(model)
	return model.Parent ~= nil and model.Parent.Name == "Lift"
		and (model.Name == "TopGate" or model.Name == "BottomGate")
end

-- Picks the part used to track whether a door has moved.
-- Returns the part and whether it's a real door panel (Door1/Door) vs a chamber's Main part.
local function getReferencePart(model)
	local p = model:FindFirstChild("Door1") or model:FindFirstChild("Door")
	if p and p:IsA("BasePart") then return p, true end
	
	p = model:FindFirstChild("Main")
	if p and p:IsA("BasePart") then return p, false end
	
	if model.PrimaryPart then return model.PrimaryPart, false end
	return nil, false
end

-- Baseline positions (assumed CLOSED at launch) for doors that only have a single moving part
local function cacheOriginalPositions()
	for _, model in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if isDoorModel(model) then
			local ref = getReferencePart(model)
			if ref and not originalPositions[ref] then
				originalPositions[ref] = ref.Position
			end
		end
	end
end
cacheOriginalPositions()

-- Returns true if the door is open. Also returns the measured gap/movement (for debugging).
local function isGateOpen(model)
	local ref, isPanel = getReferencePart(model)
	if not ref then return false, 0 end
	
	-- Instant-delete style doors (only meaningful on real door panels)
	if isPanel and (ref.Transparency > 0.5 or ref.CanCollide == false) then
		return true, 0
	end
	
	-- Two-panel doors: Door1 and Door2 touch when closed and slide apart when open
	local door2 = model:FindFirstChild("Door2")
	if isPanel and door2 and door2:IsA("BasePart") then
		local rel = ref.CFrame:VectorToObjectSpace(door2.Position - ref.Position)
		local comps = {rel.X, rel.Y, rel.Z}
		local sizes1 = {ref.Size.X, ref.Size.Y, ref.Size.Z}
		local sizes2 = {door2.Size.X, door2.Size.Y, door2.Size.Z}
		
		-- The slide axis is whichever axis the panels are offset along the most
		local axis = 1
		for i = 2, 3 do
			if math.abs(comps[i]) > math.abs(comps[axis]) then axis = i end
		end
		
		local gap = math.abs(comps[axis])
		local closedGap = (sizes1[axis] + sizes2[axis]) / 2
		return gap > closedGap + CLOSED_TOLERANCE, gap - closedGap
	end
	
	-- Single-part doors and chamber gates: open = moved away from the saved position
	local initialPos = originalPositions[ref]
	if initialPos then
		local moved = (ref.Position - initialPos).Magnitude
		local open = moved > 1.5
		
		if not isPanel then
			-- Grey box (106) gate has plain "Wall" children; the 096 gate does not
			if model:FindFirstChild("Wall") then
				if INVERT_106 then open = not open end
			else
				if INVERT_096 then open = not open end
			end
		end
		
		return open, moved
	end
	return false, 0
end

-- Finds ONE safe ClickDetector for a door. Doors with two button hitboxes
-- (one per side) toggle twice if both are fired, which cancels the action out.
local function findDoorClickDetector(model)
	for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("ClickDetector") and isSafeGameplayButton(d) then
			return d
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- action: "close" or "open"
-- cooldown (optional): seconds to skip a door after it was last clicked.
-- skipLifts (optional): leave lift gates alone (used by auto-lock).
local function executeSynchronizedAction(action, cooldown, skipLifts)
	cacheOriginalPositions()

	for _, model in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if isDoorModel(model) and not (skipLifts and isLiftGate(model)) then
			
			local onCooldown = cooldown and lastFired[model] and (os.clock() - lastFired[model]) < cooldown
			
			if not onCooldown then
				local isOpen = isGateOpen(model)
				
				-- Close = click doors that are open. Open = click doors that are closed.
				local shouldFire = (action == "close" and isOpen) or (action == "open" and not isOpen)
				
				if shouldFire then
					local cd = findDoorClickDetector(model)
					if cd then
						fireclickdetector(cd) -- only ONE click per door
						lastFired[model] = os.clock()
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

-- Each detector has independent timing, including detectors added later.
local function startSpamWorker(cd)
	if not running or not spamActive or not cd:IsA("ClickDetector")
		or not cd:IsDescendantOf(workspace) or not isSafeGameplayButton(cd) or spamWorkers[cd] then
		return
	end
	local generation = spamGeneration
	local worker = {}
	spamWorkers[cd] = worker
	task.spawn(function()
		while running and spamActive and spamGeneration == generation
			and spamWorkers[cd] == worker and cd:IsDescendantOf(workspace) do
			-- Stagger the first click as well as every subsequent click.
			task.wait(spamRandom:NextNumber(SPAM_MIN_INTERVAL, SPAM_MAX_INTERVAL))
			if not running or not spamActive or spamGeneration ~= generation
				or spamWorkers[cd] ~= worker or not cd:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
				break
			end
			-- Recheck in case the detector was renamed or moved into an excluded group.
			if isSafeGameplayButton(cd) then
				pcall(function() fireclickdetector(cd) end)
			end
		end
		if spamWorkers[cd] == worker then
			spamWorkers[cd] = nil
		end
	end)
end

track(workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(startSpamWorker))
track(workspace.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function(instance)
	spamWorkers[instance] = nil
end))


-- LIFT LOGIC (keeps lifts parked on the top floor during auto-lock) --

local liftCache = {}
local liftCacheTime = -math.huge
local liftState = {} -- [lift] = {lastPos, lastCall}

local function getLifts()
	if os.clock() - liftCacheTime > 10 then
		liftCache = {}
		for _, m in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
			if m:IsA("Model") and m.Name == "Lift"
				and m:FindFirstChild("Platform") and m:FindFirstChild("TopGate") and m:FindFirstChild("BottomGate") then
				table.insert(liftCache, m)
			end
		end
		liftCacheTime = os.clock()
	end
	return liftCache
end

-- Static reference point for a lift gate (its DoorHitbox if it has one)
local function liftGatePos(gate)
	local hb = gate:FindFirstChild("DoorHitbox")
	if hb and hb:IsA("BasePart") then return hb.Position end
	return gate:GetPivot().Position
end

-- True if the platform is closer to the top gate than the bottom gate
local function isLiftAtTop(lift)
	local pos = lift.Platform:GetPivot().Position
	local topDist = (pos - liftGatePos(lift.TopGate)).Magnitude
	local bottomDist = (pos - liftGatePos(lift.BottomGate)).Magnitude
	return topDist <= bottomDist
end

-- If a lift has stopped at the bottom, call it up using its TopGate button
local function keepLiftsOnTop()
	for _, lift in ipairs(getLifts()) do
		if lift.Parent and lift:FindFirstChild("Platform") then
			local st = liftState[lift]
			if not st then
				st = {lastPos = nil, lastCall = -math.huge}
				liftState[lift] = st
			end
			
			local pos = lift.Platform:GetPivot().Position
			local stationary = st.lastPos ~= nil and (pos - st.lastPos).Magnitude < 0.05
			st.lastPos = pos
			
			if stationary and not isLiftAtTop(lift) and (os.clock() - st.lastCall) >= LIFT_COOLDOWN then
				local cd = findDoorClickDetector(lift.TopGate)
				if cd then
					fireclickdetector(cd)
					st.lastCall = os.clock()
				end
			end
		end
	end
end


-- SPRINKLER LOGIC --

local sprinklerLeverCD = nil -- Cached lever ClickDetector
local sprinklerEmitters = {} -- Cached sprinkler particle emitters
local sprinklerSounds = {} -- Cached sprinkler audio
local lastSprinklerClick = -math.huge
local lastSprinklerSearch = -math.huge
local warnedNoParts = false
local warnedUnverified = false
local sprinklersSeenOn = false -- True once we've watched them be ON during this auto session
local sprinklerPausedAt = nil -- Time someone else turned them off (auto stays hands-off)
local sprinklerUnverified = 0 -- Clicks we made that we haven't yet seen turn the sprinklers ON
local sprinklerBlindClicked = false -- Fallback: one click made when the state can't be read

-- Finds the lever ClickDetector, sprinkler emitters and sprinkler audio
local function findSprinklerParts()
	lastSprinklerSearch = os.clock()
	sprinklerLeverCD = nil
	sprinklerEmitters = {}
	sprinklerSounds = {}
	
	for _, d in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("ClickDetector") and not sprinklerLeverCD
			and d:FindFirstAncestor("Sprinkler System Controls") and isSafeGameplayButton(d) then
			sprinklerLeverCD = d
		elseif d:FindFirstAncestor("Sprinkler System") then
			if d:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
				table.insert(sprinklerEmitters, d)
			elseif d:IsA("Sound") then
				table.insert(sprinklerSounds, d)
			end
		end
	end
end

-- Sprinklers count as ON if an emitter is actively emitting OR the sprinkler audio is playing
local function areSprinklersOn()
	for _, e in ipairs(sprinklerEmitters) do
		if e.Parent and e.Enabled and e.Rate > 0 then
			return true
		end
	end
	for _, s in ipairs(sprinklerSounds) do
		if s.Parent and s.IsPlaying then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

local function runAutoSprinklers()
	-- Re-find parts if we don't have them (searched at most every 5 seconds)
	if (not sprinklerLeverCD or not sprinklerLeverCD.Parent or (#sprinklerEmitters + #sprinklerSounds) == 0)
		and (os.clock() - lastSprinklerSearch) > 5 then
		findSprinklerParts()
	end
	
	if not sprinklerLeverCD then
		if not warnedNoParts then
			warnedNoParts = true
			warn("[Auto Sprinklers] Couldn't find the sprinkler lever. Not clicking.")
		end
		return
	end
	
	-- Fallback: the state can't be read, so click the lever ONCE and then stay hands-off
	if (#sprinklerEmitters + #sprinklerSounds) == 0 then
		if not sprinklerBlindClicked then
			sprinklerBlindClicked = true
			fireclickdetector(sprinklerLeverCD)
			warn("[Auto Sprinklers] Can't read the sprinkler state, so the lever was clicked once. Make sure they were OFF when you enabled this.")
		end
		return
	end
	
	if areSprinklersOn() then
		sprinklersSeenOn = true
		sprinklerPausedAt = nil
		sprinklerUnverified = 0
		return
	end
	
	-- Sprinklers are OFF. If we'd seen them ON, someone turned them off, so leave them off.
	if sprinklersSeenOn and not sprinklerPausedAt then
		sprinklerPausedAt = os.clock()
		sprinklersSeenOn = false
	end
	
	if sprinklerPausedAt then
		if (os.clock() - sprinklerPausedAt) < SPRINKLER_RESUME_AFTER then
			return -- stay off
		end
		sprinklerPausedAt = nil -- resume delay passed
	end
	
	-- We already clicked once and never saw them turn ON: stop instead of flipping them back off
	if sprinklerUnverified >= 1 then
		if not warnedUnverified then
			warnedUnverified = true
			warn("[Auto Sprinklers] Clicked the lever but the sprinklers never read as ON. Press 'Print & Copy Door States' and check the SPRINKLERS section.")
		end
		return
	end
	
	if (os.clock() - lastSprinklerClick) >= SPRINKLER_COOLDOWN then
		fireclickdetector(sprinklerLeverCD)
		lastSprinklerClick = os.clock()
		sprinklerUnverified += 1
	end
end

-- Builds the report, prints it to F9, and copies it to the clipboard.
-- Returns true if the clipboard copy worked.
local function printDoorStates()
	local lines = {"---------- DOOR STATES ----------"}
	local count = 0
	for _, model in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if isDoorModel(model) then
			count += 1
			local isOpen, measure = isGateOpen(model)
			local ref = getReferencePart(model)
			table.insert(lines, string.format("%s | %s | ref: %s | open-gap: %.2f",
				model:GetFullName(), isOpen and "OPEN" or "CLOSED", ref and ref.Name or "NONE", measure or 0))
		end
	end
	table.insert(lines, "Total doors found: " .. count)
	
	table.insert(lines, "---------- LIFTS ----------")
	for _, lift in ipairs(getLifts()) do
		if lift.Parent then
			table.insert(lines, string.format("%s | platform at %s", lift:GetFullName(), isLiftAtTop(lift) and "TOP" or "BOTTOM"))
		end
	end
	
	findSprinklerParts()
	table.insert(lines, "---------- SPRINKLERS ----------")
	table.insert(lines, "Lever ClickDetector: " .. (sprinklerLeverCD and sprinklerLeverCD:GetFullName() or "NOT FOUND"))
	for i, e in ipairs(sprinklerEmitters) do
		table.insert(lines, string.format("Emitter %d: Enabled=%s Rate=%s", i, tostring(e.Enabled), tostring(e.Rate)))
	end
	for i, s in ipairs(sprinklerSounds) do
		table.insert(lines, string.format("Sound %d: IsPlaying=%s Looped=%s", i, tostring(s.IsPlaying), tostring(s.Looped)))
	end
	-- List anything sprinkler-related with its class so we can see what the objects really are
	for _, d in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:FindFirstAncestor("Sprinkler System")
			and (d.Name == "Sprinkler" or d.Name == "Emitter" or d.Name == "SprinklerAudio" or d.Name == "Sound") then
			table.insert(lines, string.format("Found: %s [%s]", d:GetFullName(), d.ClassName))
		end
	end
	table.insert(lines, "Script reads sprinklers as: " .. (areSprinklersOn() and "ON" or "OFF"))
	
	local report = table.concat(lines, "\n")
	print(report)
	
	local copyFn = setclipboard or toclipboard
	if copyFn then
		local ok = pcall(copyFn, report)
		return ok
	end
	return false
end


-- BUTTON ACTIONS & CONNECTIONS --

closeDoorsBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	executeSynchronizedAction("close")
end)

openDoorsBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	executeSynchronizedAction("open")
end)

-- Spam Gameplay Buttons toggle
spamButtonsBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	spamActive = not spamActive
	spamGeneration += 1
	table.clear(spamWorkers)
	if spamActive then
		spamButtonsBtn.Text = "Spam Gameplay Buttons: ON"
		spamButtonsBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 80, 150)
		for _, cd in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
			startSpamWorker(cd)
		end
	else
		spamButtonsBtn.Text = "Spam Gameplay Buttons: OFF"
		spamButtonsBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(55, 110, 180)
	end
end)

-- 096 / 106 invert toggles: flip how open/closed is read for that gate
invert096Btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	INVERT_096 = not INVERT_096
	invert096Btn.Text = INVERT_096 and "096: Inverted" or "096: Normal"
	invert096Btn.BackgroundColor3 = INVERT_096 and Color3.fromRGB(170, 120, 40) or COLOR_OFF
end)

invert106Btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	INVERT_106 = not INVERT_106
	invert106Btn.Text = INVERT_106 and "106: Inverted" or "106: Normal"
	invert106Btn.BackgroundColor3 = INVERT_106 and Color3.fromRGB(170, 120, 40) or COLOR_OFF
end)

debugBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	local copied = printDoorStates()
	debugBtn.Text = copied and "Copied!" or "Copy not supported"
	task.delay(1.5, function()
		debugBtn.Text = "Print & Copy Door States"
	end)
end)

-- Auto-Lock Loop implementation (also keeps the lifts parked on top)
local warnedLift = false
autoCloseBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	autoCloseActive = not autoCloseActive
	if autoCloseActive then
		autoCloseBtn.Text = "Auto-Lock Loop: ON"
		autoCloseBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 45, 45)
		
		task.spawn(function()
			while running and autoCloseActive do
				executeSynchronizedAction("close", AUTO_LOCK_COOLDOWN, true) -- true = leave lift gates alone
				local ok, err = pcall(keepLiftsOnTop)
				if not ok and not warnedLift then
					warnedLift = true
					warn("[Lift] " .. tostring(err))
				end
				task.wait(0.3)
			end
		end)
	else
		autoCloseBtn.Text = "Auto-Lock Loop: OFF"
		autoCloseBtn.BackgroundColor3 = COLOR_OFF
	end
end)

-- Auto Sprinklers implementation
autoSprinklerBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	autoSprinklersActive = not autoSprinklersActive
	if autoSprinklersActive then
		autoSprinklerBtn.Text = "Auto Sprinklers: ON"
		autoSprinklerBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(55, 130, 170)
		warnedNoParts = false
		warnedUnverified = false
		sprinklersSeenOn = false -- fresh session: turn them on once, then respect anyone turning them off
		sprinklerPausedAt = nil
		sprinklerUnverified = 0
		sprinklerBlindClicked = false
		findSprinklerParts() -- Refresh in case the map changed
		
		task.spawn(function()
			while running and autoSprinklersActive do
				runAutoSprinklers()
				task.wait(0.5)
			end
		end)
	else
		autoSprinklerBtn.Text = "Auto Sprinklers: OFF"
		autoSprinklerBtn.BackgroundColor3 = COLOR_OFF
	end
end)

-- ==========================================
-- Векторная математика (Vector Math Functions)
-- ==========================================
local VectorMath = {}

function VectorMath.getDirectionUnit(origin: Vector3, target: Vector3): Vector3
    local delta = target - origin
    if delta.Magnitude < 0.0001 then
        return Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)
    end
    return delta.Unit
end

function VectorMath.getAngleDegrees(lookVector: Vector3, targetDirUnit: Vector3): number
    local dot = math.clamp(lookVector:Dot(targetDirUnit), -1, 1)
    return math.deg(math.acos(dot))
end

function VectorMath.isInVectorFOV(origin: Vector3, lookVector: Vector3, targetPos: Vector3, maxAngleDeg: number): (boolean, number)
    local dirUnit = VectorMath.getDirectionUnit(origin, targetPos)
    local angleDeg = VectorMath.getAngleDegrees(lookVector, dirUnit)
    return (angleDeg <= maxAngleDeg), angleDeg
end

-- ==========================================
-- Логика Определения Противоположной Команды
-- ==========================================
local function getNormalizedSide(player: Player): string?
    if not player then return nil end

    local ok, teamObj = pcall(function() return player.Team end)
    if ok and teamObj and teamObj.Name then
        local name = teamObj.Name:lower()
        if name:find("counter") or name == "ct" or name:find("blue") or name:find("guard") or name:find("cop") then
            return "CT"
        end
        if name:find("terror") or name == "t" or name:find("red") or name:find("robber") or name:find("inmate") then
            return "T"
        end
    end

    local okC, teamColor = pcall(function() return player.TeamColor end)
    if okC and teamColor then
        local cName = teamColor.Name:lower()
        if cName:find("blue") or cName:find("navy") or cName:find("cyan") then return "CT" end
        if cName:find("red") or cName:find("orange") or cName:find("yellow") or cName:find("brown") then return "T" end
    end

    local char = player.Character
    if char and char.Parent then
        local pName = char.Parent.Name:lower()
        if pName:find("counter") or pName == "ct" then return "CT" end
        if pName:find("terror") or pName == "t" then return "T" end
    end

    local attr = player:GetAttribute("Team") or player:GetAttribute("Side") or (char and (char:GetAttribute("Team") or char:GetAttribute("Side")))
    if attr ~= nil then
        local s = tostring(attr):lower()
        if s:find("counter") or s == "ct" or s == "2" then return "CT" end
        if s:find("terror") or s == "t" or s == "1" then return "T" end
    end

    local val = (char and (char:FindFirstChild("Team") or char:FindFirstChild("Side"))) or player:FindFirstChild("Team") or player:FindFirstChild("Side")
    if val and val:IsA("ValueBase") then
        local s = tostring(val.Value):lower()
        if s:find("counter") or s == "ct" or s == "2" then return "CT" end
        if s:find("terror") or s == "t" or s == "1" then return "T" end
    end

    local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
    if leaderstats then
        local stat = leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Team") or leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Side")
        if stat and stat:IsA("ValueBase") then
            local s = tostring(stat.Value):lower()
            if s:find("counter") or s == "ct" or s == "2" then return "CT" end
            if s:find("terror") or s == "t" or s == "1" then return "T" end
        end
    end

    return nil
end

local function isOppositeTeam(myPlayer: Player, targetPlayer: Player): boolean
    if not myPlayer or not targetPlayer then return false end
    if myPlayer == targetPlayer then return false end

    local mySide = getNormalizedSide(myPlayer)
    local targetSide = getNormalizedSide(targetPlayer)

    if mySide and targetSide then
        return (mySide ~= targetSide)
    end

    local ok1, team1 = pcall(function() return myPlayer.Team end)
    local ok2, team2 = pcall(function() return targetPlayer.Team end)
    if ok1 and ok2 and team1 ~= nil and team2 ~= nil then
        return team1 ~= team2
    end

    local okC1, color1 = pcall(function() return myPlayer.TeamColor end)
    local okC2, color2 = pcall(function() return targetPlayer.TeamColor end)
    if okC1 and okC2 and color1 ~= nil and color2 ~= nil then
        return color1 ~= color2
    end

    return true
end

getgenv().ParsaGetTeam = getNormalizedSide
getgenv().ParsaIsOpposite = isOppositeTeam

-- ==========================================
local function spawnBulletTracer(fromPos: Vector3, toPos: Vector3)
    if not Settings.BulletTracers then return end
    local distance = (toPos - fromPos).Magnitude
    if distance < 0.2 then return end

    local beamPart = Instance.new("Part")
    beamPart.Name = "ParsaBulletTracer"
    beamPart.Anchored = true
    beamPart.CanCollide = false
    beamPart.CastShadow = false
    beamPart.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    beamPart.Color = Settings.TracerColor or Color3.fromRGB(255, 41, 116)
    beamPart.Transparency = 0.15

    beamPart.Size = Vector3.new(0.08, 0.08, distance)
    beamPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(fromPos, toPos) * CFrame.new(0, 0, -distance / 2)
    beamPart.Parent = Workspace

    local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(Settings.TracerDuration or 1.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
    local tween = TweenService:Create(beamPart, tweenInfo, { Transparency = 1 })
    tween:Play()
    tween.Completed:Connect(function() beamPart:Destroy() end)

    task.delay((Settings.TracerDuration or 1.2) + 0.2, function()
        if beamPart and beamPart.Parent then beamPart:Destroy() end
    end)
end

-- Высокоточные Чамсы Скелета и Тела
-- ==========================================
local partChamsCache = {}
local highlightChamsCache = {}

local function isVisibleBodyPart(part)
    if not part:IsA("BasePart") then return false end
    local name = part.Name:lower()
    if name == "humanoidrootpart" or name == "root" or name == "hitbox" or name == "collision" then
        return false
    end
    if part.Transparency >= 0.99 then return false end
    return true
end

local function updateChams()
    if not Settings.ChamsEnabled then
        for player, partMap in pairs(partChamsCache) do
            for part, adornment in pairs(partMap) do
                if adornment and typeof(adornment) == "Instance" then adornment:Destroy() end
            end
        end
        partChamsCache = {}
        for player, highlight in pairs(highlightChamsCache) do
            if highlight and typeof(highlight) == "Instance" then highlight:Destroy() end
        end
        highlightChamsCache = {}
        return
    end

    for player, partMap in pairs(partChamsCache) do
        if not player or not player.Parent then
            for part, adornment in pairs(partMap) do
                if adornment then adornment:Destroy() end
            end
            partChamsCache[player] = nil
        end
    end
    for player, highlight in pairs(highlightChamsCache) do
        if not player or not player.Parent then
            if highlight then highlight:Destroy() end
            highlightChamsCache[player] = nil
        end
    end

    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player == LocalPlayer then continue end
        local char = player.Character
        local humanoid = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local isDead = char and (char:GetAttribute("Dead") == true or (humanoid and humanoid.Health <= 0))
        local allowed = char and not isDead and (not Settings.TeamCheck or isOppositeTeam(LocalPlayer, player))

        if allowed then
            local chamColor = Settings.ChamsColor
            if Settings.UseTeamColorChams then
                local side = getNormalizedSide(player)
                if side == "T" then chamColor = Color3.fromRGB(240, 160, 40)
                elseif side == "CT" then chamColor = Color3.fromRGB(50, 140, 240) end
            end

            if Settings.ChamsMode == "Precision Body Chams" then
                if highlightChamsCache[player] then
                    highlightChamsCache[player]:Destroy()
                    highlightChamsCache[player] = nil
                end

                if not partChamsCache[player] then partChamsCache[player] = {} end
                local partMap = partChamsCache[player]

                for _, child in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
                    if isVisibleBodyPart(child) then
                        local adornment = partMap[child]
                        if not adornment or not adornment.Parent or adornment.Parent ~= child then
                            if adornment then adornment:Destroy() end
                            adornment = Instance.new("BoxHandleAdornment")
                            adornment.Name = "Cham_" .. child.Name
                            adornment.AlwaysOnTop = true
                            adornment.ZIndex = 10
                            adornment.Parent = child
                            partMap[child] = adornment
                        end

                        adornment.Adornee = child
                        adornment.Size = child.Size
                        adornment.Color3 = chamColor
                        adornment.Transparency = Settings.ChamsFillTransparency or 0.3
                        adornment.Visible = true
                    end
                end

                for part, adornment in pairs(partMap) do
                    if not part or not part.Parent or part.Parent ~= char then
                        if adornment then adornment:Destroy() end
                        partMap[part] = nil
                    end
                end

            elseif Settings.ChamsMode == "Highlight Chams" then
                if partChamsCache[player] then
                    for part, adornment in pairs(partChamsCache[player]) do
                        if adornment then adornment:Destroy() end
                    end
                    partChamsCache[player] = nil
                end

                local highlight = highlightChamsCache[player]
                if not highlight or not highlight.Parent then
                    highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
                    highlight.Name = "FatalityChams_" .. player.Name
                    highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
                    highlight.Parent = char
                    highlightChamsCache[player] = highlight
                end

                if highlight.Adornee ~= char then highlight.Adornee = char end
                highlight.Enabled = true
                highlight.FillColor = chamColor
                highlight.OutlineColor = chamColor
                highlight.FillTransparency = Settings.ChamsFillTransparency or 0.4
                highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
            end

        else
            if partChamsCache[player] then
                for part, adornment in pairs(partMap) do
                    if adornment then adornment:Destroy() end
                end
                partChamsCache[player] = nil
            end
            if highlightChamsCache[player] then
                highlightChamsCache[player]:Destroy()
                highlightChamsCache[player] = nil
            end
        end
    end
end

-- ==========================================
-- Поиск Ближайшего Противника (Противоположная Команда)
-- ==========================================
local function getClosestEnemyPart(): BasePart?
    local Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then return nil end
    local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not root then return nil end

    local myPos = root.Position
    local closestDist = math.huge
    local closestPart = nil

    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player == LocalPlayer then continue end
        local pChar = player.Character
        if not pChar then continue end

        local humanoid = pChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local isDead = pChar:GetAttribute("Dead") == true or (humanoid and humanoid.Health <= 0)
        local isInvincible = pChar:GetAttribute("Invincible") == true
        if isDead or isInvincible then continue end
        if pChar.Parent and pChar.Parent.Name == "Debris" then continue end

        -- Атакуем ТОЛЬКО противоположную команду!
        if not isOppositeTeam(LocalPlayer, player) then continue end

        local ePart = pChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or pChar:FindFirstChild("Head") or pChar.PrimaryPart
        if ePart then
            local dist = (ePart.Position - myPos).Magnitude
            if dist < closestDist then
                closestDist = dist
                closestPart = ePart
            end
        end
    end

    return closestPart
end

local FOVCircle = Drawing.new("Circle")

FOVCircle.Color = Settings.FOVColor

local rayParams = RaycastParams.new()
rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
rayParams.IgnoreWater = true

local function isVisible(target)
    if Settings.Wallbang then return true end
    if not target or not target.Parent or not Camera then return false end
    
    rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = LocalPlayer.Character and { LocalPlayer.Character } or {}
    local origin = Camera.CFrame.Position
    local result = Workspace:Raycast(origin, target.Position - origin, rayParams)
    if not result then return true end
    local model = result.Instance and result.Instance:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
    return model and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model) ~= nil
end

local function FindSilentTarget()
    Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not Camera or not LocalPlayer.Character then 
        getgenv().ParsaSilentTarget = nil 
        return nil
    end
    
    local camPos = Camera.CFrame.Position
    local lookVec = Camera.CFrame.LookVector
    local screenCenter = Camera.ViewportSize / 2
    local closestDist = math.huge
    local closestPart = nil

    for _, player in next, Players:GetPlayers() do
        if player == LocalPlayer then continue end
        local char = player.Character
        if not char or char:GetAttribute("Dead") or char:GetAttribute("Invincible") then continue end
        if char.Parent and char.Parent.Name == "Debris" then continue end

        -- АТАКА ТОЛЬКО ПРОТИВОПОЛОЖНОЙ КОМАНДЫ
        if Settings.TeamCheck and not isOppositeTeam(LocalPlayer, player) then continue end

        local targetPart = char:FindFirstChild(Settings.HitPart) or char:FindFirstChild("Head") or char.PrimaryPart
        if not targetPart then continue end

        -- Векторная проверка угла (Vector3 & Unit Vector & Dot Product)
        local inVectorFOV, angleDeg = VectorMath.isInVectorFOV(camPos, lookVec, targetPart.Position, Settings.AutoFireAngleFOV)
        
        local screenPos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(targetPart.Position)
        if onScreen then
            local distFromCenter = (Vector2.new(screenPos.X, screenPos.Y) - screenCenter).Magnitude
            local maxRadius = Settings.UseFOV and Settings.FOVRadius or math.huge
            
            if inVectorFOV and distFromCenter <= maxRadius and distFromCenter < closestDist then
                if Settings.Wallbang or isVisible(targetPart) then
                    closestDist = distFromCenter
                    closestPart = targetPart
                end
            end
        end
    end
    getgenv().ParsaSilentTarget = closestPart
    return closestPart
end
