-- ==========================================
-- Anti-Aim Pitch & Yaw (СПИНОЙ ИМЕННО К ВРАГУ)
-- ==========================================
local originalNeckC0 = nil
local originalWaistC0 = nil
local originalRootC0 = nil
local lastCharAA = nil
local spinAngle = 0

local function getJoints()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then return nil, nil, nil, nil end

    local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
    local upperTorso = char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or char:FindFirstChild("Torso")
    local lowerTorso = char:FindFirstChild("LowerTorso")
    local rootPart = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

    local neck = (head and head:FindFirstChild("Neck")) or (upperTorso and upperTorso:FindFirstChild("Neck"))
    local waist = (upperTorso and upperTorso:FindFirstChild("Waist")) or (lowerTorso and lowerTorso:FindFirstChild("Waist"))
    local rootJoint = rootPart and rootPart:FindFirstChild("RootJoint")

    return neck, waist, rootJoint, humanoid
end

local function updateAntiAimState()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then return end

    if char ~= lastCharAA then
        lastCharAA = char
        originalNeckC0 = nil
        originalWaistC0 = nil
        originalRootC0 = nil
    end

    local neck, waist, rootJoint, humanoid = getJoints()

    if neck and not originalNeckC0 then originalNeckC0 = neck.C0 end
    if waist and not originalWaistC0 then originalWaistC0 = waist.C0 end
    if rootJoint and not originalRootC0 then originalRootC0 = rootJoint.C0 end

    if not Settings.AntiAim then
        if neck and originalNeckC0 then neck.C0 = originalNeckC0 end
        if waist and originalWaistC0 then waist.C0 = originalWaistC0 end
        if rootJoint and originalRootC0 then rootJoint.C0 = originalRootC0 end
        if humanoid then humanoid.AutoRotate = true end
        return
    end

    if humanoid then humanoid.AutoRotate = false end

    -- Если включена пауза при стрельбе и идет выстрел, выпрямляем персонажа
    if Settings.AntiAimDisableOnFire and Settings.IsFiringState then
        if neck and originalNeckC0 then neck.C0 = originalNeckC0 end
        if waist and originalWaistC0 then waist.C0 = originalWaistC0 end
        if rootJoint and originalRootC0 then rootJoint.C0 = originalRootC0 end
        return
    end

    -- Находим противника из противоположной команды
    local enemyPart = getgenv().ParsaSilentTarget or getClosestEnemyPart()
    local rootPart = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    -- Динамически разворачиваем персонажа СПИНОЙ ИМЕННО К ПОЗИЦИИ ВРАГА!
    if rootPart then
        local myPos = rootPart.Position
        local enemyPos = enemyPart and enemyPart.Position

        if enemyPos then
            local delta = Vector3.new(enemyPos.X - myPos.X, 0, enemyPos.Z - myPos.Z)
            if delta.Magnitude > 0.001 then
                -- Лицом от врага -> СПИНА НАПРАВЛЕНА ПРЯМО НА ВРАГА
                rootPart.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(myPos, myPos - delta.Unit)
            end
        elseif Camera then
            local lookDir = Camera.CFrame.LookVector
            local flatLook = Vector3.new(lookDir.X, 0, lookDir.Z)
            if flatLook.Magnitude > 0.001 then
                rootPart.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(myPos, myPos - flatLook.Unit)
            end
        end
    end

    -- Расчет Pitch
    local pitchRad = 0
    local pitchMode = Settings.AntiAimPitchMode or "Down"
    if pitchMode == "Down" then
        pitchRad = math.rad(-89)
    elseif pitchMode == "Up" then
        pitchRad = math.rad(89)
    elseif pitchMode == "Jitter" then
        pitchRad = math.rad(math.random() > 0.5 and -89 or 89)
    elseif pitchMode == "Custom" then
        pitchRad = math.rad(Settings.AntiAimAngle or -89)
    end

    -- Расчет Yaw
    local yawRad = 0
    local yawMode = Settings.AntiAimYawMode or "AtTargets"
    if yawMode == "Spinbot" then
        spinAngle = (spinAngle + (Settings.AntiAimSpinSpeed or 15)) % 360
        yawRad = math.rad(spinAngle)
    elseif yawMode == "Jitter" then
        yawRad = math.rad(math.random() > 0.5 and 90 or -90)
    elseif yawMode == "Sideways" then
        yawRad = math.rad(90)
    elseif yawMode == "Backwards" then
        yawRad = math.pi
    end

    -- Применяем CFrame к суставам
    if neck and originalNeckC0 then
        neck.C0 = originalNeckC0 * CFrame.Angles(pitchRad, yawRad, 0)
    end

    if waist and originalWaistC0 then
        waist.C0 = originalWaistC0 * CFrame.Angles(pitchRad * 0.4, 0, 0)
    end

    if rootJoint and originalRootC0 and yawMode == "Spinbot" then
        rootJoint.C0 = originalRootC0 * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, yawRad)
    elseif rootJoint and originalRootC0 then
        rootJoint.C0 = originalRootC0
    end
end

local function setViewModelVisibility(visible: boolean)
    Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera

    if Camera then
        for _, child in ipairs(Camera:GetChildren()) do
            if child:IsA("Model") or child:IsA("Folder") or child:IsA("BasePart") or child.Name:lower():find("view") or child.Name:lower():find("arm") or child.Name:lower():find("gun") then
                for _, part in ipairs(child:GetDescendants()) do
                    if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                        part.LocalTransparencyModifier = targetAlpha
                        part.Transparency = targetAlpha
                    elseif part:IsA("Decal") or part:IsA("Texture") then
                        part.Transparency = targetAlpha
                    end
                end
                if child:IsA("BasePart") then
                    child.LocalTransparencyModifier = targetAlpha
                    child.Transparency = targetAlpha
                end
            end
        end
    end

    for _, child in ipairs(Workspace:GetChildren()) do

-- ==========================================

local lastThirdPersonState = false
local originalMinZoom = 0.5
local originalMaxZoom = 128

local function updateThirdPersonState()
    if not LocalPlayer then return end
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera

    if Settings.ThirdPerson then
        local dist = Settings.ThirdPersonDist or 12
        LocalPlayer.CameraMode = Enum.CameraMode.Classic
        LocalPlayer.CameraMinZoomDistance = dist
        LocalPlayer.CameraMaxZoomDistance = dist

        if char and Camera then
            local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head") or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if head then
                for _, descendant in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
                    if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
                        descendant.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
                    end
                end

                if Settings.HideViewModelInThirdPerson then
                    setViewModelVisibility(false)
                end

                local focusPos = head.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
                local lookDir = Camera.CFrame.LookVector
                local targetCamPos = focusPos - (lookDir * dist)

                local tpRayParams = RaycastParams.new()
                tpRayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
                tpRayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { char }

                local hitResult = Workspace:Raycast(focusPos, -lookDir * dist, tpRayParams)
                if hitResult then
                    targetCamPos = hitResult.Position + (lookDir * 0.5)
                end

                Camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(targetCamPos, focusPos)
            end
        end
        lastThirdPersonState = true
    else
        if lastThirdPersonState then
            LocalPlayer.CameraMinZoomDistance = originalMinZoom
            LocalPlayer.CameraMaxZoomDistance = originalMaxZoom
            setViewModelVisibility(true)
            lastThirdPersonState = false
        end
    end
end

        local allowed = Settings.ESPEnabled and char and rootPart and not isDead
        if allowed and (camPos - rootPart.Position).Magnitude > Settings.ESPMaxDistance then allowed = false end

        if not allowed then
            if objects then
                for _, obj in pairs(objects) do if type(obj) ~= "table" then obj.Visible = false end end
                for _, bone in pairs(objects and objects.Bones or {}) do bone.Visible = false end
            end
            continue
        end

        if not objects then
            createESP(player)
            objects = espInstances[player]
        end

        local playerTeam = get_player_team(player)
        local targetColor = Settings.BoxColor
        if playerTeam and getgenv().ParsaTeamColors[playerTeam] then
            targetColor = getgenv().ParsaTeamColors[playerTeam]
        end

        local rootPos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(rootPart.Position)
        if onScreen then
            local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
            local headPos = head and Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(head.Position) or Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(rootPart.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0))
            local legPos = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(rootPart.Position - Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
            
            local height = math.abs(headPos.Y - legPos.Y)
            local width = height / 1.6
            local boxX = rootPos.X - (width / 2)
            local boxY = headPos.Y
            
            objects.Box.Visible = Settings.ESPBoxes
            objects.BoxOutline.Visible = Settings.ESPBoxes
            if Settings.ESPBoxes then
                local size = Vector2.new(width, height)
                local pos = Vector2.new(boxX, boxY)
                objects.Box.Size = size
                objects.Box.Position = pos
                objects.Box.Color = targetColor
                objects.BoxOutline.Size = size
                objects.BoxOutline.Position = pos
            end

            local isR15 = char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") ~= nil
            local activeBoneMap = isR15 and BONE_MAP_R15 or BONE_MAP_R6
            
            for i, boneLine in ipairs(objects.Bones) do
                local connection = activeBoneMap[i]
                if Settings.ESPSkeletons and connection then
                    local partA = char:FindFirstChild(connection[1])
                    local partB = char:FindFirstChild(connection[2])
                    if partA and partB then
                        local posA, visA = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(partA.Position)
                        local posB, visB = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(partB.Position)
                        if visA and visB then
                            boneLine.From = Vector2.new(posA.X, posA.Y)
                            boneLine.To = Vector2.new(posB.X, posB.Y)
                            boneLine.Color = targetColor
                            boneLine.Visible = true
                        else boneLine.Visible = false end
                    else boneLine.Visible = false end
                else boneLine.Visible = false end
            end

            if Settings.ESPNames then
                objects.Name.Text = player.Name
                objects.Name.Position = Vector2.new(rootPos.X, boxY - 15)
                objects.Name.Visible = true
            else objects.Name.Visible = false end

            if Settings.ESPDistance then
                local distance = math.floor((camPos - rootPart.Position).Magnitude)
                objects.Distance.Text = tostring(distance) .. "m"
                objects.Distance.Position = Vector2.new(rootPos.X, boxY + height + 2)
                objects.Distance.Visible = true
            else objects.Distance.Visible = false end

            if Settings.ESPHealth and humanoid then
                local barPadding, barWidth = 4, 2
                local barX = boxX - barPadding - barWidth
                local healthPercentage = math.clamp(humanoid.Health / humanoid.MaxHealth, 0, 1)
                local healthHeight = height * healthPercentage

                objects.Health.Color = Color3.fromHex("#32CD32"):Lerp(Color3.fromHex("#FF0000"), 1 - healthPercentage)
                objects.HealthOutline.Position = Vector2.new(barX - 1, boxY - 1)
                objects.HealthOutline.Size = Vector2.new(barWidth + 2, height + 2)
                objects.Health.Position = Vector2.new(barX, boxY + (height - healthHeight))
                objects.Health.Size = Vector2.new(barWidth, healthHeight)
                objects.Health.Visible = true
                objects.HealthOutline.Visible = true
            else
                objects.Health.Visible = false
                objects.HealthOutline.Visible = false
            end
        else
            for _, obj in pairs(objects) do if type(obj) ~= "table" then obj.Visible = false end end
            for _, bone in pairs(objects.Bones) do bone.Visible = false end
        end
    end
end)

-- Silent Aim Raycast Хук (Hooking)
-- ==========================================
task.spawn(function()
    if typeof(hookfunction) ~= "function" or typeof(getgc) ~= "function" then
        return
    end

    local bulletClass = nil
    for attempt = 1, 45 do
        for _, obj in next, getgc(true) do
            if type(obj) == "table" and typeof(rawget(obj, "_performRaycast")) == "function" and rawget(obj, "getTrueSpread") ~= nil then
                bulletClass = obj
                break
            end
        end
        if bulletClass then break end
        task.wait(0.5)
    end

    if bulletClass then
        local oldRaycast
        oldRaycast = hookfunction(bulletClass._performRaycast, function(...)
            local returns = table.pack(oldRaycast(...))
            local result = returns[1]
            local SilentTarget = getgenv().ParsaSilentTarget

            if type(result) == "table" then
                pcall(function()
                    local origin = rawget(result, "Origin") or (Workspace.CurrentCamera and Workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position)
                    local targetPos = nil

                    if Settings.SilentEnabled and SilentTarget and SilentTarget.Parent then
                        targetPos = SilentTarget.Position
                    else
                        local hits = rawget(result, "Hits")
                        if type(hits) == "table" and #hits > 0 and hits[#hits] and hits[#hits].Position then
                            targetPos = hits[#hits].Position
                        elseif rawget(result, "Direction") and origin then
                            targetPos = origin + (result.Direction * (result.Distance or 500))
                        end
                    end

                    if origin and targetPos then
                        spawnBulletTracer(origin, targetPos)
                        spawnHitExplosion(targetPos)
                    end

                    if Settings.SilentEnabled and SilentTarget and SilentTarget.Parent then
                        local hits = rawget(result, "Hits")
                        if type(hits) ~= "table" then return end

                        local aimPos = SilentTarget.Position
                        local lastIndex = nil
                        
                        for index, hit in pairs(hits) do
                            if type(hit) == "table" then
                                if lastIndex == nil or index > lastIndex then lastIndex = index end
                            end
                        end

                        local finalHit = lastIndex and hits[lastIndex]
                        if type(finalHit) ~= "table" then return end

                        finalHit.Instance = SilentTarget
                        finalHit.Position = aimPos
                        if finalHit.Exit ~= nil then finalHit.Exit = false end

                        if typeof(origin) == "Vector3" then
                            local delta = aimPos - origin
                            local length = delta.Magnitude
                            if length > 0.001 then
                                result.Distance = length
                                result.Direction = delta.Unit
                                
                                local unit = delta.Unit
                                for index, hit in pairs(hits) do
                                    if index ~= lastIndex and type(hit) == "table" and typeof(hit.Position) == "Vector3" then
                                        local along = (hit.Position - origin):Dot(unit)
                                        if along > length then
                                            hit.Position = origin + unit * (length * 0.5)
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end
            return table.unpack(returns, 1, returns.n)
        end)
    end
end)

local function getStuff()
	local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild("GameFolder")

	if not folder then
		return
	end

	return folder,
		folder:FindFirstChild("Zombies"),
		folder:FindFirstChild("CurrentMap")
end

local function mapEmpty()
	local _, _, map = getStuff()

	if not map then
		return false
	end

	return #map:GetChildren() == 0
end

local function getSeat()
	for _, thing in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if (thing:IsA("Seat") or thing:IsA("VehicleSeat"))
			and not thing.Disabled
			and thing.Occupant == nil then
			return thing
		end
	end
end

local function sit()
	if sitting or not seatOn then
		return
	end

	local _, zombies = getStuff()

	if not mapEmpty() then
		return
	end

	if not zombies or #zombies:GetChildren() > 0 then
		return
	end

	sitting = true

	task.spawn(function()
		for i = 1, 30 do
			if not seatOn or not mapEmpty() then
				break
			end

			local _, currentZombies = getStuff()

			if currentZombies and #currentZombies:GetChildren() > 0 then
				break
			end

			local character = player.Character
			local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local seat = getSeat()

			if humanoid and root and seat then
				if humanoid.SeatPart == seat then
					break
				end

				root.CFrame = seat.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)

				task.wait(0.1)

				if not humanoid.SeatPart and not seat.Occupant then
					seat:Sit(humanoid)
				end

				task.wait(0.1)

				if humanoid.SeatPart == seat then
					break
				end
			end

			task.wait(0.1)
		end

		sitting = false
	end)
end

task.spawn(function()
	local folder = workspace:WaitForChild("GameFolder")
	local zombies = folder:WaitForChild("Zombies")
	local map = folder:WaitForChild("CurrentMap")

	local function check()
		if not seatOn then
			return
		end

		if #zombies:GetChildren() == 0
			and #map:GetChildren() == 0 then
			sit()
		end
	end

	zombies.ChildRemoved:Connect(check)
	map.ChildRemoved:Connect(check)

	check()
end)

task.spawn(function()
	while true do

			local _, zombies, map = getStuff()

				and #zombies:GetChildren() == 0
				and #map:GetChildren() == 0 then

				local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

				if humanoid and not humanoid.SeatPart then

				end
			end
		end
	end
end)

scripts.features:
The AI behaves like an aggressive, predictive sword fighter.

It constantly searches for the nearest living opponent and follows them as its main target.

Instead of simply moving toward the opponent's current position, it watches how the opponent is moving and estimates their velocity and acceleration. It uses that information to predict where the opponent will be shortly, then moves and aims toward that predicted position.

The AI tries to avoid moving in a completely straight line. It constantly changes its footwork using randomized behaviors such as strafing, circling, moving behind the opponent, moving to the side, moving diagonally, briefly hesitating, spinning, jumping, and suddenly changing direction.

It has preferred attack-positioning behaviors. It often tries to get behind or beside the opponent instead of staying directly in front of them. Its preferred position is randomized, so its movement does not always look identical.

The AI watches the opponent's movement and can react when the opponent suddenly slows down, changes direction, or turns. When this happens, it can temporarily change its movement pattern or reposition to another side.

It also checks the surrounding space using directional sensing. This lets it determine which directions have more room and which directions are obstructed. It combines this information with its desired direction so it does not blindly move toward the opponent when that direction is unsafe or blocked.

For aiming and facing, the AI does more than simply look directly at the opponent. It evaluates several nearby possible directions and recursively compares them for a short distance into the future. It prefers directions that keep the opponent in front of it, maintain useful positioning, have better clearance, and fit its current movement.

Its turning is smoothed rather than instantly snapping toward the target. This makes its aim continuously adjust as the opponent moves.

The AI also intentionally introduces small aim and movement variations. Its facing direction contains controlled random motion, so its aim is not perfectly identical every frame.

Its movement contains momentum-like behavior. When it has been moving in a useful direction for a while, it can accumulate enough momentum in that direction to trigger a stronger side movement or repositioning maneuver.

The AI periodically rerolls some of its movement and aiming parameters. This changes the exact timing, angle, jitter, and footwork pattern, making the behavior less repetitive.

When the opponent gets close enough, the AI activates its weapon and attempts to attack.

Overall, the behavior is:

Observe opponent → track movement → predict future position → evaluate surrounding space → choose a combat direction → reposition around the opponent → adjust aim → attack when close → repeat continuously.

The AI is not actually learning. It does not remember that a certain opponent beat one of its techniques and then permanently change its strategy. Its variety comes mainly from prediction, short-horizon directional evaluation, predefined behaviors, state changes, and weighted randomness.

Its fighting style can therefore be described as:

Aggressive + predictive + evasive + circling + randomized + short-term tactical.

local gunSettingsFolder = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Modules", 5) 
and game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Modules:WaitForChild("Tools", 5) 
and game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Modules.Tools:WaitForChild("Gun", 5) 
and game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Modules.Tools.Gun:WaitForChild("Settings", 5)

local OriginalGunSettings = {}

if gunSettingsFolder then
    local ExcludedModules = {
        "Minigun", "Suppressor Minigun", "Golden Minigun", "Weedwhacker",
        "Melee", "Armor", "Throwable", "Item"
    }

    local function isGunScript(moduleScript)
        if not moduleScript:IsA("ModuleScript") then return false end
        if table.find(ExcludedModules, moduleScript.Name) then return false end
        
        local success, settings = pcall(require, moduleScript)
        if success and typeof(settings) == "table" then
            return settings.AmmoPerMag ~= nil or settings.FireRate ~= nil or settings.ProjectileObject ~= nil
        end
        return false
    end

    for _, v in pairs(gunSettingsFolder:GetChildren()) do
        if isGunScript(v) then
            local success, settings = pcall(require, v)
            if success and settings then
                OriginalGunSettings[v.Name] = {
                    AmmoPerMag = settings.AmmoPerMag,
                    FireRate = settings.FireRate,
                    Automatic = settings.Automatic,
                    Spread = settings.Spread,
                    MaxPierce = settings.MaxPierce,
                    ProjectilesPerShot = settings.ProjectilesPerShot or 1,
                    ProjectileSpeed = settings.ProjectileSpeed or 100,
                    ReloadTime = settings.ReloadTime,
                    WindUp = settings.WindUp,
                    HeadshotDamageMultiplier = settings.HeadshotDamageMultiplier,
                    EquipTime = settings.EquipTime,
                    WalkSpeedMultiplier = settings.WalkSpeedMultiplier or 1,
                    CrossExpansion = settings.CrossExpansion,
                    PumpTime = settings.PumpTime,
                    ShotgunPreReloadTime = settings.ShotgunPreReloadTime,
                    ShotgunClipinTime = settings.ShotgunClipinTime
                }
            end
        end
    end
end

local CustomBulletsAmount = 30
local CustomHeadshotMultiplier = 50
local CustomFireRateValue = 0.05
local CustomBulletsEnabled = false
local HeadshotBuffEnabled = false
local CustomFireRateEnabled = false

local function applyGunMod(gunName, modifierFunc)
    if not gunSettingsFolder then return end
    local mod = gunSettingsFolder:FindFirstChild(gunName)
    if mod then
        local success, a = pcall(require, mod)
        local orig = OriginalGunSettings[gunName]
        if success and a and orig then
            modifierFunc(a, orig)
        end
    end
end

scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

--// ASSETLER
local PHOTO_ID = "rbxassetid://131044310716749"

local JUMPSCARE_IMAGE = "rbxassetid://120214878170512"
local JUMPSCARE_SOUND = "rbxassetid://74464434454195"

--// GUI
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "SCTeamGUI"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
gui.Parent = playerGui

--// ANA PANEL
local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(250, 405)
frame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 25, 0.5, -202)
frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 18)
frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
frame.ClipsDescendants = true
frame.Parent = gui

local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 14)
corner.Parent = frame

--// ARKA PLAN
local bg = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
bg.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
bg.BackgroundTransparency = 1
bg.Image = PHOTO_ID
bg.ImageTransparency = 0.35
bg.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop
bg.ZIndex = 0
bg.Parent = frame

local bgCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
bgCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 14)
bgCorner.Parent = bg

local overlay = Instance.new("Frame")
overlay.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
overlay.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
overlay.BackgroundTransparency = 0.45
overlay.BorderSizePixel = 0
overlay.ZIndex = 1
overlay.Parent = frame

--// TITLE BAR
local titleBar = Instance.new("Frame")
titleBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 48)
titleBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 18)
titleBar.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
titleBar.BorderSizePixel = 0
titleBar.ZIndex = 5
titleBar.Parent = frame

local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -60, 1, 0)
title.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 0)
title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
title.Text = "SC TEAM GUI"
title.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
title.TextSize = 19
title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
title.ZIndex = 6
title.Parent = titleBar

--// KÜÇÜLT
local toggle = Instance.new("TextButton")
toggle.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(42, 36)
toggle.Position = UDim2.new(1, -48, 0, 6)
toggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 48)
toggle.Text = "−"
toggle.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
toggle.TextSize = 25
toggle.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
toggle.BorderSizePixel = 0
toggle.ZIndex = 7
toggle.Parent = titleBar

local toggleCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
toggleCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 9)
toggleCorner.Parent = toggle

--// BUTON ALANI
local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
holder.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 1, -70)
holder.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 58)
holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
holder.ZIndex = 5
holder.Parent = frame

local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 9)
layout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
layout.Parent = holder

local function createButton(text)
	local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
	b.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 45)
	b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 30)
	b.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
	b.BorderSizePixel = 0
	b.Text = text
	b.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	b.TextSize = 16
	b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	b.ZIndex = 6
	b.Parent = holder

	local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
	c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
	c.Parent = b

	return b
end

--// PARTICLE
local particleButton = createButton("PARTICLE")

particleButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local char = plr.Character
		local head = char and char:FindFirstChild("Head")

		if head then
			local old = head:FindFirstChild("SCPhotoParticle")
			if old then
				old:Destroy()
			end

			local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
			attachment.Name = "SCPhotoParticle"
			attachment.Parent = head

			local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
			emitter.Texture = PHOTO_ID
			emitter.Rate = 12
			emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(1, 2)
			emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(1, 3)
			emitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180)
			emitter.Rotation = NumberRange.new(0, 360)
			emitter.RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(-100, 100)
			emitter.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.8)
			emitter.Parent = attachment
		end
	end
end)

--// DECAL
local decalButton = createButton("DECAL")

decalButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
			for _, face in ipairs(Enum.NormalId:GetEnumItems()) do

				local old = obj:FindFirstChild("SCPhoto_" .. face.Name)

				if old then
					old:Destroy()
				end

				local decal = Instance.new("Decal")
				decal.Name = "SCPhoto_" .. face.Name
				decal.Texture = PHOTO_ID
				decal.Face = face
				decal.Parent = obj
			end
		end
	end
end)

--// SKYBOX
local skyboxButton = createButton("SKYBOX")

skyboxButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

	local old = Lighting:FindFirstChild("SCTeamSky")

	if old then
		old:Destroy()
	end

	local sky = Instance.new("Sky")
	sky.Name = "SCTeamSky"

	sky.SkyboxBk = PHOTO_ID
	sky.SkyboxDn = PHOTO_ID
	sky.SkyboxFt = PHOTO_ID
	sky.SkyboxLf = PHOTO_ID
	sky.SkyboxRt = PHOTO_ID
	sky.SkyboxUp = PHOTO_ID

	sky.CelestialBodiesShown = false
	sky.Parent = Lighting
end)

--// JUMPSCARE
local jumpscareButton = createButton("JUMPSCARE")

jumpscareButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

	local old = gui:FindFirstChild("SCJumpscare")

	if old then
		old:Destroy()
	end

	local jumpscare = Instance.new("Frame")
	jumpscare.Name = "SCJumpscare"
	jumpscare.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	jumpscare.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0)
	jumpscare.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	jumpscare.BorderSizePixel = 0
	jumpscare.ZIndex = 100
	jumpscare.Parent = gui

	local image = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
	image.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	image.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0)
	image.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	image.Image = JUMPSCARE_IMAGE
	image.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Stretch
	image.ZIndex = 101
	image.Parent = jumpscare

	local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
	sound.Name = "JumpscareSound"
	sound.SoundId = JUMPSCARE_SOUND
	sound.Volume = 1
	sound.Parent = jumpscare

	sound:Play()

	if not sound.IsLoaded then
		sound.Loaded:Wait()
	end

	if sound.TimeLength > 0 then
		task.wait(sound.TimeLength)
	else
		sound.Ended:Wait()
	end

	if jumpscare and jumpscare.Parent then
		jumpscare:Destroy()
	end
end)

--// PP EFEKTİ
local ppButton = createButton("PP")

local ppEffect = nil
local ppConnection = nil
local ppRunning = false

local function stopPP()
	ppRunning = false

	if ppConnection then
		ppConnection:Disconnect()
		ppConnection = nil
	end

	if ppEffect then
		ppEffect:Destroy()
		ppEffect = nil
	end
end

ppButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

	-- Açıkken tekrar basılırsa kapat
	if ppRunning then
		stopPP()
		return
	end

	ppRunning = true

	ppEffect = Instance.new("Frame")
	ppEffect.Name = "SCPP"
	ppEffect.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	ppEffect.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0)
	ppEffect.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	ppEffect.ZIndex = 90
	ppEffect.Parent = gui

	--// BÜYÜK FOTOĞRAF
	local bigPhoto = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
	bigPhoto.Name = "SunPhoto"
	bigPhoto.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(170, 170)

	bigPhoto.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	bigPhoto.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.45, 0)

	bigPhoto.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	bigPhoto.Image = JUMPSCARE_IMAGE
	bigPhoto.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop
	bigPhoto.ZIndex = 92
	bigPhoto.Parent = ppEffect

	local bigCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	bigCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	bigCorner.Parent = bigPhoto

	--// FOTOĞRAFIN ETRAFINDAKİ ÇİZGİ
	local orbit = Instance.new("Frame")
	orbit.Name = "Orbit"
	orbit.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(250, 250)

	orbit.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	orbit.Position = UDim2.new(0, 115, 1, -115)

	orbit.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	orbit.ZIndex = 91
	orbit.Parent = ppEffect

	local orbitCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	orbitCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	orbitCorner.Parent = orbit

	local orbitStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	orbitStroke.Thickness = 3
	orbitStroke.Transparency = 0.15
	orbitStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	orbitStroke.Parent = orbit

	--// KÜÇÜK DÜNYA
	local smallPhoto = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
	smallPhoto.Name = "OrbitPhoto"
	smallPhoto.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(52, 52)

	smallPhoto.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)

	smallPhoto.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	smallPhoto.Image = JUMPSCARE_IMAGE
	smallPhoto.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop
	smallPhoto.ZIndex = 95
	smallPhoto.Parent = orbit

	local smallCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	smallCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	smallCorner.Parent = smallPhoto

	--// SOL ALT TARAFA HAREKET
	local moveTween = TweenService:Create(
		bigPhoto,
		TweenInfo.new(
			3,
			Enum.EasingStyle.Sine,
			Enum.EasingDirection.InOut
		),
		{
			Position = UDim2.new(0, 115, 1, -115)
		}
	)

	moveTween:Play()

	moveTween.Completed:Wait()

	if not ppRunning then
		return
	end

	--// YÖRÜNGE DÖNÜŞÜ
	local angle = 0

	ppConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(deltaTime)

		if not ppRunning then
			return
		end

		angle = angle + (deltaTime * 100)

		local radians = math.rad(angle)

		local radius = 125

		local x = math.cos(radians) * radius
		local y = math.sin(radians) * radius

		smallPhoto.Position = UDim2.new(
			0.5,
			x,
			0.5,
			y
		)
	end)
end)

--// CLEAR ALL
local clearButton = createButton("CLEAR ALL")

clearButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

	-- Particle
	for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do

		local char = plr.Character
		local head = char and char:FindFirstChild("Head")

		if head then

			local particle = head:FindFirstChild("SCPhotoParticle")

			if particle then
				particle:Destroy()
			end
		end
	end

	-- Decal
	for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do

		if obj:IsA("BasePart") then

			for _, child in ipairs(obj:GetChildren()) do

				if child:IsA("Decal")
					and string.sub(child.Name, 1, 8) == "SCPhoto_" then

					child:Destroy()
				end
			end
		end
	end

	-- Skybox
	local sky = Lighting:FindFirstChild("SCTeamSky")

	if sky then
		sky:Destroy()
	end

	-- Jumpscare
	local jumpscare = gui:FindFirstChild("SCJumpscare")

	if jumpscare then
		jumpscare:Destroy()
	end

	-- PP
	stopPP()
end)

--// SÜRÜKLEME
local dragging = false
local dragStart
local startPos
local dragInput

titleBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)

	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

		dragging = true
		dragStart = input.Position
		startPos = frame.Position

		input.Changed:Connect(function()

			if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
				dragging = false
			end

		end)
	end
end)

titleBar.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)

	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

		dragInput = input
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)

	if input == dragInput and dragging then

		local delta = input.Position - dragStart

		frame.Position = UDim2.new(
			startPos.X.Scale,
			startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
			startPos.Y.Scale,
			startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
		)
	end
end)

--// KÜÇÜLT / AÇ
local minimized = false
local savedSize = frame.Size

toggle.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

	if not minimized then

		minimized = true

		savedSize = frame.Size
		holder.Visible = false

		frame.Size = UDim2.new(
			savedSize.X.Scale,
			savedSize.X.Offset,
			0,
			48
		)

		toggle.Text = "+"

	else

		minimized = false

		frame.Size = savedSize
		holder.Visible = true

		toggle.Text = "−"
	end
end)

			ball.CanCollide = true
			humanoid.PlatformStand = true

			end

			end
		end)

		humanoid.Died:Connect(function() tc:Disconnect() end)
	end)

    bg      = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 20),
    bg_card = Color3.fromRGB(24, 24, 32),
    bg_input= Color3.fromRGB(34, 34, 44),
    accent  = Color3.fromRGB(0, 220, 180),
    purple  = Color3.fromRGB(140, 100, 255),
    danger  = Color3.fromRGB(240, 70, 90),
    gold    = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 60),
    warn    = Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 60),
    text    = Color3.fromRGB(235, 235, 245),
}

-- FIX 500K (TURUN DARI 1M) + RADIUS AUTO
local FIXED_LOOP = 500000
local FIXED_BATCH = 2500
local CLICK_RADIUS = 5000

    spamEnabled = false,
    loopCount = FIXED_LOOP,
    batchSize = FIXED_BATCH,
    successCount = 0,
    blockedCount = 0,
    detectors = {},
    fps = 60,
    fpsHistory = {},
    normalFpsCounter = 0,
    unspamActive = false,
}

local function log(msg)
    print("[KHENZ] " .. msg)
end

-- ============ FPS TRACKER ============
local frameCount = 0
local lastFpsUpdate = tick()

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    frameCount = frameCount + 1
    local now = tick()
    if now - lastFpsUpdate >= 0.5 then
        local elapsed = now - lastFpsUpdate
        local currentFPS = math.floor(frameCount / elapsed)
        State.fps = currentFPS
        table.insert(State.fpsHistory, currentFPS)
        if #State.fpsHistory > 6 then table.remove(State.fpsHistory, 1) end
        frameCount = 0
        lastFpsUpdate = now
    end
end)

local function avgFPS()
    if #State.fpsHistory == 0 then return State.fps end
    local sum = 0
    for _, v in ipairs(State.fpsHistory) do sum = sum + v end
    return math.floor(sum / #State.fpsHistory)
end

-- ============ AUTO UNSPAM ============
task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        task.wait(1)
        if _G.AUTO_UNSPAM and State.spamEnabled then
            local fps = avgFPS()
            if fps > 50 then
                State.normalFpsCounter = State.normalFpsCounter + 1
                if State.normalFpsCounter >= 5 then
                    State.unspamActive = true
                    log("AUTO UNSPAM: 5s")
                    task.wait(5)
                    State.unspamActive = false
                    State.normalFpsCounter = 0
                    log("AUTO UNSPAM: done")
                end
            else

            end
        end
    end
end)

    local detectors = {}
    for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetChildren()) do

            local board = obj:FindFirstChild("Board")
            if board then
                local cd = board:FindFirstChild("ClickDetector")
                if cd and cd:IsA("ClickDetector") then
                    table.insert(detectors, cd)
                end
            end
            for _, v in ipairs(obj:GetDescendants()) do
                if v:IsA("ClickDetector") then
                    table.insert(detectors, v)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if #detectors == 0 then
        for _, v in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            if v:IsA("ClickDetector") and v.Parent then
                local p = v.Parent
                local gp = p.Parent
                if p.Name:lower():find("board")
                   or (gp and gp.Name:lower():find("board"))
                   or (gp and gp.Name:lower():find("billboard")) then
                    table.insert(detectors, v)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return detectors
end

        task.wait(2)

end)

            local curBatch = FIXED_BATCH

                    task.wait(1)
                    local waitCount = 0

                        task.wait(0.5)

                    end

                    curBatch = 250

                end
            end

local dragging, dragStart, startPos
topbar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
       or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true; dragStart = input.Position; startPos = main.Position
    end
end)
topbar.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
       or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then dragging = false end
end)
UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
                     or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
        local d = input.Position - dragStart
        main.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + d.X,
                                  startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + d.Y)
    end
end)

local function makeBtn(text, color, callback)
    local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
    b.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 26)
    b.BackgroundColor3 = color
    b.TextColor3 = THEME.bg
    b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    b.TextSize = 10
    b.Text = text
    b.AutoButtonColor = false
    b.Parent = btnHolder
    Instance.new("UICorner", b).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)
    b:SetAttribute("CurrentColor", color)

    b.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        local c = b:GetAttribute("CurrentColor") or color
        TweenService:Create(b, TweenInfo.new(0.1), {
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(math.min(c.R + 0.15, 1),
                                          math.min(c.G + 0.15, 1),
                                          math.min(c.B + 0.15, 1))
        }):Play()
    end)
    b.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        local c = b:GetAttribute("CurrentColor") or color
        TweenService:Create(b, TweenInfo.new(0.1), { BackgroundColor3 = c }):Play()
    end)
    b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() callback(b) end)
    return b
end
